college_info.intro:
Sri Krishna College of Technology comprises several departments, including the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, the Department of Electrical Engineering, and the Department of Engineering Design, among others. Through its departments, SKCT Coimbatore offers various UG, PG, and PhD courses.
The BTech and MTech programmes offered at the Sri Krishna College of Technology are very popular among the students. The institute offers a four-year BTech programme and a two-year MTech programme in numerous specialisations. The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum, which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of technology. SKCET Coimbatore also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in top companies. The notable SKCT Coimbatore recruiters include Microsoft, Google, Accenture, Amazon, Infosys, Bosch, Capgemini, and HCL, among others. faqs.question: Q: Is Sri Krishna College of Technology [SKCT] a known college/Institute?

faqs.answer: Sri Krishna College of Technology (SKCT), situated in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu and established in 1985 under Sri Krishna Institutions, on a sprawling 52-acre campus in Kovaipudur. SKCT operates as an autonomous institute affiliated with Anna University, Chennai, and is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi. Accredited with an A Grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), and undergraduate programs accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA), New Delhi. Sri Krishna College of Technology Offers 11 undergraduate and 6 postgraduate programs in Engineering, Technology, and Management studies.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good overall.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, sports ground, and other facilities, including the cafeteria, are all in good condition as of now. Food availability in the hostel is average. Medical facilities are good, and sports facilities are average. Mess food isn’t that great, but at the same time, it isn’t so bad, it’s manageable.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges for better placement offers and a better future.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good and more facilitated classrooms with smart boards, and even lessons will be taught in a technical way. Actually, staff are advised not to use blackboards, they are advised to use only the smart boards. Hostels are also very well maintained and will be a more secure one, food will be good in the canteens, and stationery is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall this is tired-3 college, come here only if you have no choice left.
reviews.review_text: The MBA class they set up is inside the campus of SKACS. Labs are not equipped with the latest technology, classrooms in air-conditioned ones, no library facilities if you want to have a book u need to travel and reach skct campus and there it is even the worst. The attention they give to sports is very poor, a guy who already has prior records is given priority, overall in these aspects, they consider MBA students as refugees both in SKACS and SKCT campuses.

reviews.review_heading: The placements are good in this college. The trainers are good in their way of teaching.
reviews.review_text: The facilities on our campus are quite good to look and the infrastructure is well-maintained. Wi-Fi facilities are available for all students to access. Classrooms are bigger ones with good space. Food quality is average in hostel and the taste is not that good. Sports and games are given importance for the students who are willing and the matches are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good place, and I love it.
reviews.review_text: I love the infrastructure very much. There aremany trees are available which maintains cool in the college. Provide good feeling. The college is under a mountains. Garden are maintained nicely. Students have many sitting areas. The college infrastructure is very beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. Placement offers are great and have very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connections are available throughout the college. Classrooms and library are good. Hostel is good, but the food is not good and only vegetarian food is served.

reviews.review_heading: College has good infrastructure and is good for placements.
reviews.review_text: Each classroom has separate Wi-Fi facilities that students can access. Library has more number of books which is good enough for students to study. Classrooms are cleaned and maintained nicely. Hostel food is good and a room is shared by 4 members. All types of sports are available in our college and competitions are held each year.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and well-maintained campus.
reviews.review_text: College is good discipline-wise. Classrooms are moderate. Library is good. Wi-Fi is only available in some places. Medical facilities are available for hostel students. Hostel is not good. In hostel, hygiene is not good. Laundry services are provided. In hostel, evening snacks are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Sri Krishna College of Technology [SKCT].
reviews.review_text: Hostel stay is good and comfortable for both boys and girls. Both hostels are secured. There is more security in girls' hostel and more restrictions. Girls hostel is much better than boys'. There are all needed facilities inside the hostel itself like shops, stationery shops, printer shops, and food courts. All types of foods are available and everything is inside the college hostel and provide good infrastructure good facilitated lab.

reviews.review_heading: Good and excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: High-speed Wi-Fi connectivity is available. Fully equipped labs with the latest software tools and machines are available for practical sessions. Smart classrooms with projectors, audio systems, and air conditioning facilitate interactive learning. The quality of food was very good; our hostel consists of only vegetarian options. It is very clean and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: My college review at SKCT.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure and location are very good and beautiful. Wi-Fi facilities are available in all areas of the campus. College classrooms have smart boards. College food is average. Only vegetarian food is available in hostel if we need non-vegetarian we have to buy from outside of the college hostel gate. Sports activities are a little bit average in our college.

reviews.review_heading: My college life at SKCT.
reviews.review_text: The best thing in the girls' hostel is the core safety. Every outing and on-duty of the students will be strictly monitored. Food will be of average good quality and will be hygienic. There are drinking water facilities, a dobi for washing clothes, and vending machines available.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful memories of our youth life.
reviews.review_text: In our hostel, they provide vegetarian food, and compared to other hostels here food is average. There is a laundry system for students. Inside the hostel, they provide a canteen, Cockroko, fresh juice, a beauty parlor, a tailor, and a stationery shop. It provides a gym and a gym trainer also. The warden is strict. They do not allow students to go out there as there are so many rules, even for final years.

reviews.review_heading: Partially satisfied because the student can learn more than academics.
reviews.review_text: In our department, the electronics labs are in decent condition, and the electrical lab is also decent, but old devices are used. There are some poor internet connections available. Library facilities are available. The hostel is not good enough compared to its fees.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Krishna College of Technology - Best.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure on this campus provides us more knowledge, and the labs have more information and tools to get hands-on experience. The classrooms have smart classes, and they have videos depicting classes. The teaching is up to the mark, where every new technology is being taught.

review_summary.college_name: IIMT Greater Noida Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: All over, good college, good infrastructure and good campus life.

content.Placements: Placement is very good for those students who studied very well, and placement is good. The highest package is 44 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The percentage of students who placed is 83%. Top recruiters include companies like Paytm, Axis Bank, EY, and all in CSE (AI). The package is high compared to the CSE core.
content.Infrastructure: There is a hostel facility. 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. A gym is available. The quality of food is not very good because it is not nutritious. The canteen meal is overall good, but the prices of canteen food are high, not too high but still high. Sports activities include cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am very satisfied with my college. The facilities are great here.

content.Placements: Placement is very good. They provide placement in the 3 to 5 LPA range normally, but in some other cases, it goes near 10 to 12 LPA. Event management, HR (human resources), event planner, manager, business analytics, and business development roles are offered. The maximum number of students is placed every year.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are great. The infrastructure is really nice. The library is also very good. Canteens are kept neatly. We have two hostels, one for boys and one for girls. We also have 4 canteens which provide a variety of food, including Chinese, continental, South Indian, and beverages.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Law (LL.B.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My raw and uncut review of my college.

content.Placements: Our college usually provides internships in the LL.B. course in local courts or under advocates for a better experience in the field. They try to provide as many students as they can, the rest depend on students' own choice and their skills. The percentage of students who get jobs and internships lies between 80 and 90 percent.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of IIMT is really good and a quite big enough campus we have there. We have spacious classrooms, a different library for each department, and Wi-Fi is also available in each building. Classes are air-conditioned, which is a really good thing, especially in the summer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best college in India: IIMT Group of Institutes, Greater Noida.

content.Placements: In Information Technology, placement is not very high but still good, around 70-80%. So, it’s a good choice even if you choose B.Tech at IIMT Greater Noida. The education system provided by IIMT Greater Noida group of institutes is professional and focused.
content.Infrastructure: Best features available on campus are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library, where everyone has free access to the Wi-Fi connection. So, it’s the best option available on campus. You also have access to Wi-Fi in your hostel room or can use free internet.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am fully satisfied with the faculty, classrooms, and events organised by the college.

content.Placements: I am 1st year B.Tech CSE AI student. I have seen my seniors who passed out this year, and they get an average package that ranges from 6-7 LPA. Many students get a package of more than 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Accenture, Amazon, Just Dial, Toppr, and Tech Mahindra.
content.Infrastructure: There is a separate building for each branch and course. Wi-Fi is good in speed. Each class contains projectors and a smart board for students. Labs are fully furnished. The PPS lab is fully air-conditioned, and the electrical and electronic labs have all the equipment for experiments. The mechanical lab is very big and contains all the equipment. The food quality of the hostel is quite satisfactory, and not too bad. The medical room is available with a doctor. An ambulance is also available in case of an emergency.

reviews.review_heading: All over, good college, good infrastructure and good campus life.
reviews.review_text: There is a hostel facility. 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. A gym is available. The quality of food is not very good because it is not nutritious. The canteen meal is overall good, but the prices of canteen food are high, not too high but still high. Sports activities include cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with my college. The facilities are great here.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are great. The infrastructure is really nice. The library is also very good. Canteens are kept neatly. We have two hostels, one for boys and one for girls. We also have 4 canteens which provide a variety of food, including Chinese, continental, South Indian, and beverages.

reviews.review_heading: My raw and uncut review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIMT is really good and a quite big enough campus we have there. We have spacious classrooms, a different library for each department, and Wi-Fi is also available in each building. Classes are air-conditioned, which is a really good thing, especially in the summer.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in India: IIMT Group of Institutes, Greater Noida.
reviews.review_text: Best features available on campus are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library, where everyone has free access to the Wi-Fi connection. So, it’s the best option available on campus. You also have access to Wi-Fi in your hostel room or can use free internet.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the faculty, classrooms, and events organised by the college.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate building for each branch and course. Wi-Fi is good in speed. Each class contains projectors and a smart board for students. Labs are fully furnished. The PPS lab is fully air-conditioned, and the electrical and electronic labs have all the equipment for experiments. The mechanical lab is very big and contains all the equipment. The food quality of the hostel is quite satisfactory, and not too bad. The medical room is available with a doctor. An ambulance is also available in ...

reviews.review_heading: IIMT College is the best college, but there is only one issue with placement.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is excellent. The college is well-facilitated. There are many facilities for students, such as a library, canteen, and free internet throughout the campus. Every classroom has digital boards. Washrooms are clean, and the staff is helpful. There are many more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of helpful faculty members, good placements, and great college campus.
reviews.review_text: College campus has free Wi-Fi facilities for all the students. There are air-conditioned labs and libraries making it comfortable for students to study. College campus is quite big with a lot of greenery and with garden. There are also many sports grounds on college campus for sports like cricket, basketball, and kho-kho.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIMT Group of Colleges, Greater Noida.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure at IIMT College of Engineering include academic facilities like well-equipped classrooms, modern labs, a robust Wi-Fi-enabled campus, and a library with over 2,00,000 books and journals. We have separate hostels for boys and girls with air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms. It provides a hygienic environment and essential amenities. Mess and canteen offer decent and nutritious meals with a variety of options. Sports facilities include indoor and outdoor game...

reviews.review_heading: I am disappointed due to the lack of good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the college is good with decent classrooms, proper seating arrangements and a good Wi-Fi facility across the campus. The library is well-maintained and offers a variety of books. Yet, the labs need some improvement as some equipment is outdated or not functioning properly. The hostel facilities are average, and the food in the mess is manageable but could be improved in both quality and variety. Sports facilities are available but limited.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the college is good but students need to work on themselves
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. Wi-Fi is only available in the library, not in classrooms. The quality of food is also not satisfactory. The hostel is comparable to those at other colleges, but there are issues with Wi-Fi connectivity. Medical facilities are inadequate, and the sports facilities are the worst I have ever seen.

reviews.review_heading: The college focuses on the student's skills and education.
reviews.review_text: Facilites in hostels are personal lockers for storming your belongings, shared common areas, bathroom and showers, free Wi-Fi, access to washing machines, locally sourced meals (breakfast, lunch, and dinner ), and oragnise social events such as trips or social nights. Hostels are the best services providing hostels. The food is also delicious, and the wardens take care of students like their own kids.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good and the infrastructure is nice.
reviews.review_text: Classroom infrastructure is good. There are labs in all the departments and classrooms are also good with smart board facilities. There is also a library in which we can issue the books and all the departments have Wi-Fi also. The food quality of the mess is good, and all the facilities are good at the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college faculty members and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a lot of facilities like better cafeteria canteens, and neat and clean classrooms, and the infrastructure of our college is the best. I am happy to take admission here; the infrastructure is so big. Our college provides us with library facilities, Wi-Fi, and labs. They teach us Tally and Excel.

reviews.review_heading: IIMT steps further into the future.
reviews.review_text: The course infrastructure is quite good, but I would not recommend the college hostel. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The hostel has facilities, but they are not up to the expected standards. The food is sometimes hygienic and may not suit the tastes of many. I recommend renting a room or opting for a PG nearby, as there are several options available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, IIMT Group of Colleges, Greater Noida is good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. It has good Wi-Fi, a good library, and good classrooms. Everything is good. I think the mess food is bad. I do not stay at the hostel. Medical facilities are average. Labs are good, and the computer lab is also good. The transportation facility is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery (BHMS) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: A good college for learning and to get clinical exposure in homeopathy.

review_content.Placements: Around 70% of students from my batch got placed. The college mainly focuses on clinical practice, higher studies, and government jobs, so placements are moderate. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is 6 LPA. Some top recruiters include homeopathic pharma companies, research institutes, private clinics, wellness centers, and a few hospital chains.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has a decent infrastructure with well-maintained classrooms, laboratories, dissection halls, and a central library that provides access to standard homeopathic and medical textbooks. Wi-Fi facility is available, but mostly limited to the library and computer sections. Classrooms are equipped with projectors for teaching. The hostel facilities are average with basic amenities like clean rooms, drinking water, and security. The mess food is simple and hygienic, but not very diverse, as it's mostly home-style. The canteen provides snacks and basic meals at reasonable rates.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The college is very good for students.

review_content.Placements: Placements in ACC are quite decent and can be considered above average compared to many other courses. In our batch, around 70-75 percent of students were successfully placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered went up to around 10 LPA while the lowest was about 3 LPA and the average package for most students ranges between 4.5 and 5 LPA. The placement cell is active and invites a good number of companies every year, giving students multiple opportunities to explore.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is quite good and supports the overall learning experience of students. The classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated with adequate seating capacity and most of them are equipped with projectors for smart teaching. The laboratories are well-maintained and all the required equipment and instruments are available for practical learning. The library is also well-stocked with textbooks, reference books, journals and digital resources. High-speed Wi-Fi facilities are available across the campus, making it convenient for students to access study materials and complete assignments.

content.Placements: Around 60-70 percent of students receive an internship program through the department. Common intership providers are in research labs, pharma companies, and university departments. The recruiting companies are biotech, pharma, and healthcare companies visited on the campus.
content.Infrastructure: The department provides good facilities. All books of every course are available in the library. Food quality in the canteen is very good. The canteen offers additional options for students. Hostel facilities are decent and well-maintained. Reference books and journals are available in the library which is helpful for assignments and research.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I suggest going to Charusat or Parul University if you have money.

content.Placements: Maybe 85% of students got placed. The average package is 3 LPA-10 LPA, and 10 LPA is the highest. Infosys, Reliance, ICICI Bank, and Cipla. 50% of students got internships in Reliance and Infosys, I guess. There are no top roles offered in companies, they only suggest lower roles that help us to understand.
content.Infrastructure: College has good labs and library, but not that good. No hostel is available. You have to arrange a hostel on your own. Canteen food is the worst and very expensive. They have a medkit, kind of, but not like good for emergencies, as the college is very far from any hospital. Sports and games are very good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery (BHMS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A good college for learning and to get clinical exposure in homeopathy.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students from my batch got placed. The college mainly focuses on clinical practice, higher studies, and government jobs, so placements are moderate. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is 6 LPA. Some top recruiters include homeopathic pharma companies, research institutes, private clinics, wellness centers, and a few hospital chains.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a decent infrastructure with well-maintained classrooms, laboratories, dissection halls, and a central library that provides access to standard homeopathic and medical textbooks. Wi-Fi facility is available, but mostly limited to the library and computer sections. Classrooms are equipped with projectors for teaching. The hostel facilities are average with basic amenities like clean rooms, drinking water, and security. The mess food is simple and hygienic, but not very diverse, as it's mostly home-style. The canteen provides snacks and basic meals at reasonable rates.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is very good for students.

content.Placements: Placements in ACC are quite decent and can be considered above average compared to many other courses. In our batch, around 70-75 percent of students were successfully placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered went up to around 10 LPA while the lowest was about 3 LPA and the average package for most students ranges between 4.5 and 5 LPA. The placement cell is active and invites a good number of companies every year, giving students multiple opportunities to explore.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is quite good and supports the overall learning experience of students. The classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated with adequate seating capacity and most of them are equipped with projectors for smart teaching. The laboratories are well-maintained and all the required equipment and instruments are available for practical learning. The library is also well-stocked with textbooks, reference books, journals and digital resources. High-speed Wi-Fi facilities are available across the campus, making it convenient for students to access study materials and complete assignments.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery (BHMS) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: College is very good for studying.

content.Placements: Our college hospital is very good. Many patients come to the hospital. An internship is provided by our hospital. The monthly salary for the internship is five thousand. The hospital is very good for the practice of homeopathy. Our hospital provides the best facilities.
content.Infrastructure: The college is very good. Smart boards are available in classrooms. The library is very good for homeopathic students. All types of books are available in the library. The labs are good. Wi-Fi is available in the college. A canteen is not available in the college. The hostel's mess food is good.

admission_overview.college_name: Sardar Patel University Admission 2025: Application Process, Eligibility, Fees

paragraphs: Sardar Patel University (SPU) offers admissionin 200+ degree programmes and diploma courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. It offers programmes in the streams ofScience,Business,Management Studies,Nursing,Arts,Law,Social Work, and many more. Furthermore,SPUalso provides a range of skill-based add-on courses to students. SPU accepts applications through online mode.Sardar Patel University admission criteriafor various courses at the university is merit in the last qualifying examination or the scores in entrance exams. Read the following article to get detailed information aboutSPUVVN admission.

SPU course admissionis entrance-based for all courses.Theuniversity offers admission to various courses based the different criteria, which are either merit in the qualifying exam or the scores obtained by the candidates in the entrance exams accepted by the university. Besides this, the university also conducts an entrance exam for students to get admission to the desired course.The University accepts various national-level entrance exams to shortlist candidates for admission. However, the candidates are required to meet the course-specific eligibility criteria to apply for admission at Sardar Patel University. Interested candidates can check out the table below for the eligibility and selection criteria ofSPUVVN courses:

Candidates pursuing a course can avail of financial aid in the form ofSardar Patel University Scholarships. Below is theSPU feeand the Average package for top courses:

Candidates looking to join the university need to ensure that they fulfil the preset admission criteria of the course. The application process for the university mainly commences online. Students seeking to join the university need to ensure that they go through the multi-step process of admission which includes application, selection, and admission confirmation. Find below the steps to complete theSardar Patel University admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Visit the official website of the university and apply for the desired programme by filling out the application form available online. Students may obtain the form offline from the university campus as well.
Step 2: Selection Process

Students are mainly shortlisted based on national-level entrance tests. Candidates must fulfil the basic eligibility in addition to providing valid entrance exam scores. Some of the entrance exams accepted by the university include CMAT, UGC NET, NATA, etc.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to go through document verification and pay the admission fees to secure their spot at the university.

reviews.review_heading: PBS has the best faculty, infrastructure and excellent off-campus drives.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-grade in PBS. All the classrooms are well-equipped with AC's, Wi-Fi and digital classrooms. The whole campus has internet facility and other amenities like seminar hall, auditorium, GD rooms, placement cell rooms, library, computer lab, etc. The campus has ATM and a stationery too.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure with good facilities. Excellent faculty.
reviews.review_text: Pune business school campus is lush green and has excellent infrastructure. The classrooms has Wi-Fi and projector facility. We have computer labs for students where they can complete and study different projects. The canteen is very clean and hygienic. We get good and healthy breakfast, lunch and dinner. We have basketball court, hand ball court in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent. For guest lectures and formal gatherings, the college offers a unique seminar hall. Full smart class projectors, classrooms, and libraries are well-structured and maintained. Classrooms are good and air-conditioning in our college. A large canteen and cafe are also available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is top-notch with modern facilities
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure on the campus is top-notch with modern facilities like digital classrooms and seminar halls, the campus in which PBS is located is the biggest campus of all the three campuses of the PCET group. Wi-Fi on all respective buildings is available. Computer labs and library are regularly updated with new technologies and books. College is located in heart of a residential area where the railway station is nearby and all the industrial and IT hubs are nearby.

reviews.review_heading: Well-equipped infrastructure
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped infrastructure in terms of computer labs, library, classrooms, conference room, the auditorium is provided. The whole campus has an internet facility. The campus has a playground, gymnasium, hostel, and mess. Separate mess for boys and girls and an additional cafeteria is available on campus .

reviews.review_heading: Excellent on and off-campus drives
reviews.review_text: The college has well-equipped modern computer labs and well-stocked libraries in all the sections of the campus, student can have access to any of the same. ATM and stationery are within the campus itself, campus is a lush green campus. All the classrooms and seminar halls are in excellent condition and equipped with modern amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: Both boys and girls hostel facilities are available on the campus with spacious rooms. The campus also has full-sized football, cricket, and basketball courts. Classrooms are digital and are well lit and ventilated. The mess facility is available on campus with excellent food quality. There is also a cafe where students can have their favorite snacks.

review_summary.college_name: BSE Institute Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Predictive Analytics (Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best college in Mumbai for practical training.

content.Placements: The number of placements offered by this college is higher than what you would find at most other colleges. The highest package was around 8 Lacs, and the lowest was around 6 Lacs. The college places students with companies such as Cardekho. They offer internships to all students pursuing the course, and the role offered is data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities at this college are excellent. The classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-equipped with Wi-Fi. There is also a well-stocked library and a variety of student activities are offered. All of these things create a fun and productive environment for students.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Predictive Analytics (Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of BSE Institute Limited, Mumbai.

content.Placements: Many students got placed in our college with good salary packages. The salary packages depend on students' skills. Morningstar, Motilal Oswal, etc., visit our college.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides Wi-Fi. Classrooms are good. The library has only a few books. We will get the best finance-related books. There are different canteens in our college. They provide good food.
content.Faculty: Teachers are good. Few teachers have worked in MNCs. The course curriculum is relevant. If you study well, you can pass exams with good marks. The pass percentage is 50%.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Certificate in Banking and Finance - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college is worth for money, but there are little tweaks.

content.Placements: There are no that much good placements, and around 70% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. The average salary package offered is 5 LPA. Bar, ICCL, Kotak Bank, IDFC, Motilal, etc., are the top recruiters of our course. Operational, sales and researcher roles are offered here. The highest salary package offered in our course is 8 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA and the average salary package offered is 4 LPA. About 70% of students get internships in companies like BSE, ICCL, Motilal and banks.

individual_reviews.course: - Batch of 2013

content.Other: BSE Institute gives a firsthand experience of Indian financial markets. It gives you an opportunity to get in direct touch with industries main leaders which gives you a real market lookout. It is a good value for money for people looking for not very expensive MBA. The library is very extensive and provides a good range of books. Study here is made simpler by using new forms of teaching. At the end it depends on the candidate.

individual_reviews.course: Master in Management Studies (Financial Technology) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a good and unique college.

content.Placements: There are many courses available here with the best placement management. Companies like Wipro and TCS come for placements. The package depends on the campus, with a starting 6-7 LPA. The placement team helps you in every situation, so you don't have to worry about anything.
content.Infrastructure: There are many classrooms with unique names like Mumbai, Paris, etc. The staff is friendly, and security is good. There is Wi-Fi with high speed, and there are people who help in emergencies. They have a clean place, the bathrooms are also clean, and the food is tasty.

faqs.question: What is the admission process at VNSGU?
faqs.answer: The university conducts entrance exams for admission to courses, including BFA, BPT, BOPTM, BSc (Nursing), etc. Admission to the MBBS course at VNSGU is based on the NEET-UG score. Veer Narmad South Gujarat University accepts national-level exam scores for PG course admissions. For MBA, the CAT/CMAT score is accepted. While MD and MS courses admissions are through NEET-PG.

faqs.question: What types of courses are offered at VNSGU Surat?
faqs.answer: VNSGU Surat offers plenty of courses for students. The university provides more than 30+ courses at the Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and doctoral levels. The university also offers certificate courses to its students. The specialisation range from Science, Accounting & Commerce, Mass communication and Media to Architecture, Humanities, etc. Admissions are granted on the basis of an entrance exam.

faqs.question: Do I need to give any entrance exam required for Veer Narmad South Gujarat University BCom admissions?

admission_process.title: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering admission 2025is open for all courses. The institute offersBTech, MTech, and MBAat UG and PG levels respectively. All these courses are offered under the affiliation ofVisvesvaraya Technological University. Admission to UG and PG courses atVidyavardhaka College of Engineeringis entrance-based. The institute accepts various entrance exams, includingCOMEDK, UGET, KCET, CMAT, KMAT, and GATEfor admission to BTech, MBA, and MTech courses. Interested applicants can apply by visiting the official website of the institute. To know more aboutVidyavardhaka College of Engineeringadmission, along with eligibility and selection criteria, go through the following sections:

Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering admissionto its UG and PG courses is entrance-based. Applicants seeking admission toVidyavardhaka College of Engineering coursesare required to meet the eligibility criteria of their desired courses and then appear for the selection process accepted by the institute. Thebasic eligibilityfor allUG and PG coursesisClass 12 and graduation,respectively and the selection for most of the UG and PG courses isentrance-based. Interested candidates can check out the table below forVidyavardhaka College of Engineering courses,along with their eligibility and selection:
Eligibility

Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering admissionis entrance-based for all the courses. Applicants are required to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process to get admission. Find below the detailedVidyavardhaka College of Engineering admission process 2025:
Step 1: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering Application Process 2025

TheVidyavardhaka College of Engineering application processis carried out in online mode. Applicants must apply by visiting the official websites of respective courses using basic details such as personal and educational qualifications.
Step 2: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering Selection Rounds 2025

After filling out the online application form, applicants must appear for the respectiveentrance examfor their desired courses. The shortlisted candidates have to appear for furthercounselling roundsfor their desired courses.
Step 3: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering Final seat Allocation

After the completion of all the selection rounds and counselling rounds. The institute releases the cutoff list of the shortlisted applicants. Students who get their names on the cutoff list are then requested to visit the institute for reporting, upload documents, and pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, SMS Varanasi accepts CUET-UG for BCom, BBA, BCA and BA (Hons) courses. CUET-PG is accepted for MBA, MCA and MCom programmes. individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college is good for students.

content.Placements: Placement chances are good, and the placement percentage is 90 percent. Many companies visit the college for placements. In my course, placements are a bit low because many students prefer to do an MBA after BBA for better placement. The college tries its best for placements of students who are interested.
content.Infrastructure: My college provides the best facilities and infrastructure. It has AC labs with all working computers. The library has all kinds of books and PYQs, which are very important for students. Wi-Fi is also available. In the hostel, facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My college should focus on sports, and the canteen should have more variety!

content.Placements: BBA students don't get any placement; you have to get a postgraduate degree. It's average. I think my sister is doing an MBA from the same college, the School of Management Sciences, and she is really a good student. Every time she scores more than 8 CGPA, she gets a placement of 10 lakh.
content.Infrastructure: There is a good infrastructure at my college, especially from the outside. I think they should improve more UG buildings, but PG buildings are amazing, like a university. The garden area is amazing, and the library is amazing, but the conference hall should be bigger because it is too small!

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My overall experience at the college has been fairly positive.

content.Placements: I am a part of the BBA from the 2022-2025 batch. 60-70% of students from the batch get placed through campus recruitment. The highest package is 5 LPA. The lowest package is 2.4 LPA. The top recruitment company is HDFC Bank.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is good. The mess food is also good. There are many facilities for sport, and many types of games are played. In the hostel, Wi-Fi is available. The internet speed is also good. The library is also available in my college, and in the library, no phones are allowed.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty, but not satisfied with the language of students.

content.Placements: Our college offers good placements. I think it is the best college in Varanasi and in Purvanchal. It also ranks among the top 50 business colleges in India. There are also many holidays, and we don't need to worry about attendance. The college is open only 5 days a week.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Our college provides computer labs, a library, a sports ground, and a lush green campus. The campus of the college is big. We can freely move inside the campus. The canteen also offers good food. There is also separate parking for students inside the college. It offers good food.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college you can find in Varanasi.

content.Placements: Students should be placed if they want placement, but students want to pursue MCA. That’s why the college invites fewer companies. The college invites companies that students are capable of cracking the interview with. And it depends on how many students want to sit for the interview.
content.Infrastructure: For our course, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are provided. Every day, we attend six classes, two in the library and lab, where we can practice coding. Our college offers sports like cricket, volleyball, and a gym. The hostel quality and canteen are good, but the mess could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: College with the legacy of the Chhatrapatis, good infrastructure, and decent placements
reviews.review_text: The college has a canteen, library, computer lab, language lab, placement cell, seminar hall, and auditorium, and even has its own stationery shop. Free Wi-Fi is provided for students for educational purposes. The classrooms are spacious and can hold up to 100 students, equipped with smart boards and a proper ventilation system. The college doesn't provide hostel facilities, though a majority of students come from outside Pune.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with nice crowd, supportive faculty members and perfect director.

Medical facilities are also provided in our college, and academic facilities also make the college more perfect. We have lots of sports opportunities here which makes us feel energised and refreshed.

reviews.review_heading: AISSMS is the perfect choice for BBA/MBA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure building is very good, with very good classes, and the seminar hall is good. The hostel is a bit expensive. Please research well when coming as the hostel is too good but a little expensive, Rs. 43,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: I opted for the hostel as the place is good and safe. Rooms are spacious as well as maintained. In the hostel, we used to interact a lot with our seniors as well as with students of other departments.

The BTech programme is offered in 12 specialisations, such as Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science etc. The MBA programme is offered in six specialisations, some of them are Financial Management, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management etc.

Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology admission process 2025 is completely online. Candidates can visit the official website and register along with the payment of the registration fee. Details around the admission criteria and fees for allRKGIT coursesoffered by this institute are listed below:

Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology is open for applications in all its courses. To enter, the candidates need to complete the registration process. Candidates must fill in their details, including name, email, phone number, and work experience.In some cases, an application fee may be required.

review_summary.college_name: NMIT Bangalore Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Structural Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good for the masters.

content.Placements: Students are eligible for placements from the 3rd semester. Companies such as Atkins, Brigade, and Shoba visited the college. The highest package offered is 7 LPA. About 70 percent of students got placed. I plan to do a Ph.D. after this. The college provides internship opportunities. Stipends vary, with some being unpaid. Projects include various attributes, helping students gain hands-on experience and industry exposure from time to time as well.
content.Infrastructure: NMIT provides on-campus hostels for both boys and girls with 1689 capacity. Twin-sharing rooms are available for 1st year students. Second year onwards, boys may opt for twin-sharing or four-sharing rooms. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Computer labs are spacious and have a good number of PCs. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and also air-conditioned. The library is good, and open till 12:00 AM.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a very expensive college, but in Bangalore, it is common.

content.Placements: Coming to the campus placements, the placements have been going on for almost 4 months, and the majority of my friends have been placed. To be honest, they have multiple offers. Each person has gotten a minimum offer of 4 LPA, and the big companies are ready to come, so coming to the placements, they are really good.
content.Infrastructure: On campus, international students live in the hostel. All the students are helpful and belong to other parts of the world and the country. Mostly, 5:2 boys to girls live in the hostel campus, and there is equal respect for all. We celebrate all important functions on the hostel campus together. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The hostel is good, and their mess is super. I'm sure you won't get better food at home than in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Structural Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Please do some serious study and aim for IIT.

content.Placements: Students are eligible for placements from the 3rd sem. Companies such as Atkins Brigade and Shoba visited the college. The highest package offered was 7LPA. 70 Percent of students got placed. I plan to do a Ph.D. after this. There were internships provided by TCS Wipro and many companies.
content.Infrastructure: The library was vast with lots of books available. The classroom had projectors. We had a huge ground for sports. Clubs such as theatre club fashion club etc. Hostels were good they were mostly two seated. Mess food was average. Wi-Fi was all over the campus. There were cricket grounds volleyball court and many other grounds present.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I’m fortunate to be part of this institution.

content.Placements: About 40% of students are placed as of now. 15 LPA is the highest and 6 LPA is the lowest. Some Japanese companies, Oracle, Rabbit AI, Capgemini, and Accenture are the top recruiters. About internships, I don't have any idea. Roles offered are AI analyst, assistant engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms come with LED screens, a projector, and Wi-Fi. Hostels are provided with all the amenities, but students have to compromise with food. I’m a day scholar but have friends in the hostel who give mixed reviews about the hostel facilities. They have 24/7 medical support.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: We have good faculty and placements.

content.Placements: More than 90% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 8 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is around 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Microsoft and TCS. Around 80% of students receive internship opportunities. The top roles offered are HR and Manager positions.
content.Infrastructure: The department facilities are good, and the overall infrastructure is also good. We have Wi-Fi in every classroom within the department. The library facilities are also good. The hostel is good with decent food. Rooms and washrooms are also good. There is also a ground in front of the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good for the masters.
reviews.review_text: NMIT provides on-campus hostels for both boys and girls with 1689 capacity. Twin-sharing rooms are available for 1st year students. Second year onwards, boys may opt for twin-sharing or four-sharing rooms. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Computer labs are spacious and have a good number of PCs. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and also air-conditioned. The library is good, and open till 12:00 AM.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very expensive college, but in Bangalore, it is common.
reviews.review_text: On campus, international students live in the hostel. All the students are helpful and belong to other parts of the world and the country. Mostly, 5:2 boys to girls live in the hostel campus, and there is equal respect for all. We celebrate all important functions on the hostel campus together. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The hostel is good, and their mess is super. I'm sure you won't get better food at home than in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Please do some serious study and aim for IIT.
reviews.review_text: The library was vast with lots of books available. The classroom had projectors. We had a huge ground for sports. Clubs such as theatre club fashion club etc. Hostels were good they were mostly two seated. Mess food was average. Wi-Fi was all over the campus. There were cricket grounds volleyball court and many other grounds present.

reviews.review_heading: I’m fortunate to be part of this institution.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms come with LED screens, a projector, and Wi-Fi. Hostels are provided with all the amenities, but students have to compromise with food. I’m a day scholar but have friends in the hostel who give mixed reviews about the hostel facilities. They have 24/7 medical support.

reviews.review_heading: We have good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: The department facilities are good, and the overall infrastructure is also good. We have Wi-Fi in every classroom within the department. The library facilities are also good. The hostel is good with decent food. Rooms and washrooms are also good. There is also a ground in front of the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good library. It has collection of online and offline books. We have good facilities. Good interaction is there with students. We have good football court for playing games. There is a basketball court as well for sports. It has good facilities in general. The clubs are good as well in all departments.

reviews.review_heading: A wonderful experience in this green campus.
reviews.review_text: All the rooms are well-maintained and very hygienic. The food is good but it provides the same food every week. There is a medical center. There are various labs with high technology. There are places where students get a chance to focus on physical development. There is a gym and sports activities too.

reviews.review_heading: It is quite good until it became a university and stopped taking admissions from COMEDK and KCET.
reviews.review_text: We have big rooms in the hostels and smart classrooms in the college, with good sanitation that gets cleaned daily. There is a big football ground, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostels. The mess food is not quite to my liking, even though they have improved it.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with supportive faculty and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers a supportive academic environment with well equipped classrooms. Along with projectors and campus-wide Wi-Fi. It makes learning more interactive. Labs, especially in electronics, VLSI, and computing, are regularly updated. This gives us practical exposure beyond theory. The central library is a major advantage. It has a wide collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Along with quiet study space for focused learning.

reviews.review_heading: A short note on NMIT College.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi in NMIT is very poor, and the mobile network is hectic. I hate this thing about our college, the Wi-Fi network is not good, and mobile network is the worst. We can't send any message, or sometimes we don't get OTPs, etc. The labs here are good, and the systems are new, and they run smoothly.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, helpful faculty members, and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure for both academics and hostel. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards, while the labs are well-maintained with high-speed internet and updated software for practical learning. Library has a wide collection of books and digital resources. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and hostel. The food in the mess and canteen is average but hygienic, with multiple options available. Medical facilities are provided on campus along with emergency su...

reviews.review_heading: An average College with a good placement ratio.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are all good. They are good, knowledgeable, and all classrooms have access to Wi-Fi.  Love for different types of things. Library is overall good facilities. We got a ground to play on, and the canteen and the Mess are also nice. The food served is good.

reviews.review_heading: It has supportive faculty, a strong curriculum, and good placements. It is a great choice for E&C.
reviews.review_text: There are four boys' hostels and two girls' hostels. Rooms are furnished with a bed, study table, chair, wardrobe, shared common rooms, TV, reading or music rooms, solar water heaters, LAN+Wi-Fi, 24x7 power backup via generators, water coolers, and full security with CCTV. Mess offers both North and South Indian meals, with options to order extra items beyond the standard menu.

reviews.review_heading: NMIT Bengaluru provides good placements for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The college has classrooms, labs, and libraries with high-speed internet facilities provided. You can make self-preparation on your own.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and lectures.
reviews.review_text: College provided good hotel facilities like mineral water, water coolers, and washing machines. The bedrooms were good with attached bathrooms. The food quality was good. College infrastructure was good. The classrooms were in good condition. Labs were well qualified. Wi-Fi connection was available. Many books were available in the library. The medical facilities were good.

review_summary.college_name: MNNIT Allahabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is fine, placements are good. Campus life is decent.

content.Placements: Placement season is all around, and most of the seniors I know have been placed at the start of their final year. Top recruiting companies are often Goldman Sachs, and there are also second years who got internships this year. Some were doing GSoC. Since the beginning, there have been three major domains that one can go for: app development, web development, and AI/ML. App development has a somewhat lesser environment here, as most want to do either web development or AI/ML. Though there are students who are quite passionate about app development.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the infrastructure, the faculty is good, but 75% attendance is mandatory.

content.Placements: In the Computer Science branch of MNNIT, around 96 percent of eligible students got placed. The highest package offered is 72 LPA while the average package is 27 LPA. The lowest package is around 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. 20-30 percent of students got internships in their pre-final year. Top roles are offered, including software developers, full-stack developers, data analysts, etc. Overall, good placement opportunities in MNNIT as in CSE.
content.Infrastructure: Decent infrastructure of classrooms and labs, including a good LAN connection in labs. Well-maintained library with over a thousand books for the course and other interests. The hostel for the first year is decent, LAN connections are available in all rooms. Only the vegetarian mess is present in the hostel, providing decent food. One canteen is in the hostel which is open late at night, and one stationery shop is also in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 60 percent of civil engineering students got placed from this college. The highest package for civil engineering students is approximately 39 LPA. The average package for civil engineering students is approximately 13 LPA. The lowest package is not available.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is very good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of the mess food may be of decent quality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best placements. Average infrastructure. Average sports facilities.

content.Placements: Placements are really good for Computer Science Engineering, Electronics, and Communication Engineering. Talking about my branch, Civil Engineering, this year our senior Abhinandan sir has got a package of 22 Lacs per annum. This college is known for its best placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite average if I compare this college to other colleges like NIT Jaipur. 1st year and 4th year hostels are good, but 2nd and 3rd year hostels have small rooms. Mess food is average. The internet connection is not good enough to play games unless you have 5G.

individual_reviews.title: The college has good placement, good infrastructure, and facilities.

description: MNNIT Allahabad cutoff 2025 for BTech, MTech, and other courses are available on this page. Candidates preparing for the next academic session can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the MNNIT Allahabad JEE Main cutoff 2025 along with other exams for different courses, rounds, and categories. Further exam-related updates are below:

In this section, candidates can view the last nine years of MNNIT Allahabad JEE Main cutoff ranks for various courses and categories by clicking on the download now links provided below to understand the past years' trends.

MNNIT Allahabad JEE Main cutoff 2025 for the first and last rounds are tabulated below for the General AI category students. In the last round, the MNNIT Allahabad CSE cutoff 2025 was 5423 in the General category belonging to the AI quota. For other core branches, such as ECE and Mechanical, the JEE Main last round closing ranks for admission were 10568 and 26234, respectively for the General category. The cutoff ranks for core BTech branches are usually on the lower side, indicating competitive

For the General AI category students, the MNNIT Allahabad B.E. / B.Tech cutoff 2025 ranged between 5423 and 48979 in the last round. Considering the lowest cutoff ranks of 5423 and 10568, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering were the top two most competitive branches for admission among the students belonging to the General category.

JEE Main is the accepting exam for admission to the BTech and other UG courses. Qualified candidates are then eligible for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling process for final seat allocation. In this section, aspirants can find out all the important JEE Main 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

JoSAA counselling 2025 is now over for admission to the Engineering courses offered at MNNIT Allahabad. In 2025, the JoSAA counselling was conducted for up to six rounds. Further counselling rounds were conducted by CSAB to fill the vacant seats. Students who appeared for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling rounds can refer to the table below to view or download the round- and year-wise JEE Main cutoff lists for BTech admission at MNNIT Allahabad to understand the cutoff trends.

Tabulated below are the BTech specialisations available for admission based on the last round closing ranks of JEE Main. This will help students to make an informed decision to get the right college and specialisation for admission. The options below are available for students belonging to the General AI quota and are in the range of the most competitive BTech specialisation of MNNIT Allahabad. To refine their searches, students can also use the provided filters.

As per the GATE cutoff 2025, the top two most challenging M.E./M.Tech specialisations were M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (AI and Data Science) with last round cutoff scores of 656 and 631, respectively, for the General AI quota. In the table below, candidates can view the branch-wise first and last round cutoff scores.

Tabulated below are the GATE CCMT last round cutoff scores for 2025, 2024 and 2023 across different rounds, categories and quotas. For the General AI quota, the last round cutoff scores varied between 350 and 656. While for the OBC category students, the final round cutoff scores were concluded between the range of 303 and 610 in the AI quota.

Candidates can refer to the table below to view some of the important GATE 2026 dates to be eligible for admission to the ME/MTech course. GATE is the accepting exam, followed by the CCMT counselling process for admission.

Tabulated below are the GATE cutoff lists across different rounds and years for ME/MTech admission at MNNIT Allahabad - Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology. The consolidated cutoff list will help students understand the past years cutoff trends.

MNNIT Allahabad CCMN cutoff 2025 concluded with the release of the final seat allotment result for MSc/MSc Tech courses. M.Sc. in Mathematics and Scientific Computing turned out to be the most competitive option with a lowest last round closing rank of 739 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. The easiest option for admission was M.Sc. in Physics, as the admission cutoff was comparatively more relaxed for the students. The last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 1691.

MNNIT Allahabad M.Sc. cutoff 2025 was released up to 5 rounds for different categories of students belonging to the AI quota. In 2025, the maximum cutoff rank was 1691 for M.Sc. admission in the General AI category. Please note that the cutoff rank differs for different specialisations, rounds and categories. Considering the last round cutoff, M.Sc. in Mathematics and Scientific Computing emerged as a top choice among the General category, with its cutoff rank settling at 739.

CCMN is the centralised platform for admissions to the MSc and MSc (Tech Programmes) at NITs, IIEST Shibpur, and some CFTI institutes that accept the IIT JAM scorecard. This year, CCMN counselling was conducted for three regular rounds and two special rounds for MSc admission across different participating institutes. Candidates preparing for MNNIT Allahabad admission can refer to the table below to view or download the year- and round-wise CCMN cutoff list.

The last round of the MNNIT Allahabad NIMCET cutoff 2025, along with the concluding round cutoffs of 2024 and 2023, is given in the information here. For the General AI quota, the last round closing rank was 150 for MCA admission in 2025. For the same course, the closing rank was 181 in 2024, while in 2023, it was 178. Analysing the three-year cutoff ranks, it is clear that MNNIT Allahabad saw inconsistency in the last round closing ranks over three years for MCA admission.

MNNIT allahabad also accepts DASA UG scores for BE/ BTech and BArch admission. Candidates seeking admission to MNNIT Allahabad can refer to the table given below to check out the DASA UG previous year cutoffs for the General category students:

Considering the last round of MNNIT Allahabad CCMT cutoff 2025, core M.E./M.Tech branches, including Computer Science and Engineering and Computer Science and Engineering (AI and Data Science), witnessed higher cutoffs for admission, while branches such as Information Security and Microelectronics and VLSI Design had comparatively relaxed cutoff scores for admission in the General category under the AI quota.

Through the years, the NIRF rankings for MNNIT Allahabad indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. When evaluated against the ranking of the past years, it has been noticed that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend. In 2025, MNNIT Allahabad's rank is #151, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. reviews.review_heading: College is fine, placements are good. Campus life is decent.
reviews.review_text: The library is fine. It has a lot of books and online resources. The hostel for first years is also good. Don't believe people who want to be relatable. Hostel food and facilities are quite nice, the food is fine, and there are three food outlets on campus. The mess is pure veg, so it's a good option for those who don't want non-veg. Medical facilities are also good. There is an on-campus ambulance, and they also take us to hospitals outside, even at night, and medicines are free from the dispen...

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the infrastructure, the faculty is good, but 75% attendance is mandatory.
reviews.review_text: Decent infrastructure of classrooms and labs, including a good LAN connection in labs. Well-maintained library with over a thousand books for the course and other interests. The hostel for the first year is decent, LAN connections are available in all rooms. Only the vegetarian mess is present in the hostel, providing decent food. One canteen is in the hostel which is open late at night, and one stationery shop is also in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of the mess food may be of decent quality.

reviews.review_heading: Best placements. Average infrastructure. Average sports facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite average if I compare this college to other colleges like NIT Jaipur. 1st year and 4th year hostels are good, but 2nd and 3rd year hostels have small rooms. Mess food is average. The internet connection is not good enough to play games unless you have 5G.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placement, good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is really good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of mess food may be of decent quality.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of the mess food may be of decent quality.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements. Good coding culture. Enough facilities to grant you a good college life.
reviews.review_text: Almost all the classes are AC equipped. The library is of considerable size. College Wi-Fi gives about average speed. Lunch and dinner are just average, but breakfast is good. The canteen contains all the essential items. The college has many clubs for sports. Overall, 1st-year hostels are good, but 2nd- and 3rd-year hostels are not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: College is decent. Placement-wise, very good, but campus life is not so good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, is, I say at weaker side, campus is not a big building, the classes are very old and boring, and the hostel facility is not good. First and last year hostels are good, but the second or third are very bad.

reviews.review_heading: It's good. At the start, it could be humbling.
reviews.review_text: CSE labs are good, though in our labs, many equipments does not work. 4-5 people's group perform a single experiment, it's miserable, even classrooms of the core department other than electrical have some miserable classrooms, sometimes rain water pour through their ceilings.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good in placement, faculty, course structure, and strict in rules.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good but not that much decent like other NITs, all the facilities are available like Wi-Fi, LAN, classrooms, and library which are fine but 2nd and 3rd year. Hostels are not that good but the facilities in hostels are fine. Mess food is also good, fully vegetarian, only eggs are available in the canteen. Medical facilities are also fine, an ambulance is available 24 hours, and the college dispensary is open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. There are so many sports and club societies in...

reviews.review_heading: The college is good in terms of software placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very old, and the campus area is small. Most of the campus area is allotted to faculty and girls where boys are not allowed so campus infrastructure is poor, and the maintenance hostel is average but the mess is below average. Labs and classrooms are old-fashioned.

reviews.review_heading: Brilliant placement college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is poor and dull with a very small campus. Very small for boys half of what it is, old buildings. The library is good, Wi-Fi is available in academic buildings, labs are well connected with the network, and proper enabled PC. Mess food is bad, canteen is good, and it offers a variety of food. Sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Inside details of MNNIT Allahabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent, not very Hi-Fi and not very bad as well. The hostel for first-year and final-year boys are the best. The grounds are good, 2 badminton courts in the first year boys hostel (SVBH), and a table tennis room on every floor. The mess food is not very good. You have to manage. LAN connections are provided in each room so no problem. Classrooms are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the placement only of the MNNIT brand only.
reviews.review_text: Poor facilities and not-so-good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available in the library, the computer centre is fully centralized, and classrooms are currently under construction. The facilities are not so good, the mess food is average, and the canteen is not so well in the hostels. College medical facilities are also poor, with limited sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Top college with a great return on investment.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have decent facilities with some of them being air-conditioned. The library has a wide variety of books and good Wi-Fi, the hostel rooms and mess are usually clean and the food is usually alright. Sports and games facilities are alright. The canteen has a good variety of foods.

paragraphs: NIT Durgapur admissionsare entrance-based for UG and PG courses. The institute offers admission through national-level entrance exams and counselling.BTechis the flagship programme of NIT Durgapur, admission to which is based onJEE Main rankfollowed byJoSAAandCSAB Counselling. MTech admission requiresGATE score.

National Institute of Technology course admissionsare also based on respective counselling bodies. The institute offers BTech, MTech, MSc, MBA, Integrated MSc, etc. at UG and PG levels in Engineering and Science streams.
Students wishing to apply for admission at NIT Durgapur must follow all the steps from registration to counselling.

National Institute of Technology Durgapur, also known asNIT Durgapur, offers UG, PG, dual degree, and PhD admission. Candidates need to qualify a minimum of Class 12 for NIT Durgapur UG courses and graduation for PG programmes. NIT Durgapur seat intake varies course-wise. Candidates need to qualify entrance exam accepted for the selected course to get a seat in the institute. The seat for BTech and MTech is distributed category-wise. Below is the NIT Durgapur seat intake for top courses:

NIT Durgapur admissionsbegin with opening of applications. Since admission to most of the programmes is entrance-based, candidates are required to apply through the entrance exam. Below is the step-wiseNIT Durgapur admission process:
Step 1: NIT Durgapur Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Durgapur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to MBA and PhD courses need to apply on the official website of the institute.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech programme, NIT Durgapur admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly, for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Durgapur MBA admissions are done through CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The selected candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.
