description: NIT Durgapur cutoff 2025 for BTech, MTech, and other courses are available on this page. Candidates preparing for the next academic session can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the NIT Durgapur JEE Main cutoff 2025 along with other exams for different courses, rounds, and categories. Further exam-related updates are below:

In this section, candidates can view the last nine years of NIT Durgapur JEE Main cutoff ranks for various courses and categories by clicking on the download now links provided below to understand the past years' trends.

NIT Durgapur JEE Main cutoff 2025 for the first and last rounds are tabulated below for the General AI category students. In the last round, the NIT Durgapur CSE cutoff 2025 was 12268 in the General category belonging to the AI quota. For other core branches, such as ECE and Mechanical, the JEE Main last round closing ranks for admission were 18024 and 34291, respectively for the General category. The cutoff ranks for core BTech branches are usually on the lower side, indicating competitive cuto

For the General AI category students, the NIT Durgapur B.E. / B.Tech cutoff 2025 ranged between 12268 and 65181 in the last round. Considering the lowest cutoff ranks of 12268 and 14996, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing were the top two most competitive branches for admission among the students belonging to the General category.

JEE Main is the accepting exam for admission to the BTech, B.Sc. and other UG courses. Qualified candidates are then eligible for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling process for final seat allocation. In this section, aspirants can find out all the important JEE Main 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

JoSAA counselling 2025 is now over for admission to the Engineering courses offered at NIT Durgapur. In 2025, the JoSAA counselling was conducted for up to six rounds. Further counselling rounds were conducted by CSAB to fill the vacant seats. Students who appeared for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling rounds can refer to the table below to view or download the round- and year-wise JEE Main cutoff lists for BTech admission at NIT Durgapur to understand the cutoff trends.

Tabulated below are the BTech specialisations available for admission based on the last round closing ranks of JEE Main. This will help students to make an informed decision to get the right college and specialisation for admission. The options below are available for students belonging to the General AI quota and are in the range of the most competitive BTech specialisation of NIT Durgapur. To refine their searches, students can also use the provided filters.

As per the GATE cutoff 2025, the top two most challenging M.E./M.Tech specialisations were M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science with last round cutoff scores of 562 and 561, respectively, for the General AI quota. In the table below, candidates can view the branch-wise first and last round cutoff scores.

Tabulated below are the GATE CCMT last round cutoff scores for 2025, 2024 and 2023 across different rounds, categories and quotas. For the General AI quota, the last round cutoff scores varied between 350 and 562. While for the OBC category students, the final round cutoff scores were concluded between the range of 309 and 533 in the AI quota.

Candidates can refer to the table below to view some of the important GATE 2026 dates to be eligible for admission to the ME/MTech course. GATE is the accepting exam, followed by the CCMT counselling process for admission.

Tabulated below are the GATE cutoff lists across different rounds and years for ME/MTech admission at NIT Durgapur - National Institute of Technology. The consolidated cutoff list will help students understand the past years cutoff trends.

NIT Durgapur CCMN cutoff 2025 concluded with the release of the final seat allotment result for MSc/MSc Tech courses. M.Sc. in Applied Geology and Geoinformatics turned out to be the most competitive option with a lowest last round closing rank of 293 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. The easiest option for admission was M.Sc. in Physics, as the admission cutoff was comparatively more relaxed for the students. The last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 1522.

NIT Durgapur M.Sc. cutoff 2025 was released for 5 rounds across different categories of students belonging to the AI quota. In 2025, the maximum cutoff rank needed was 1522 for M.Sc. admission in the General AI category. Cutoff rank varies for different specialisations, rounds and categories. As per the last round cutoff, M.Sc. in Applied Geology and Geoinformatics emerged as a top choice among the General category, with its cutoff rank settling at 293.

CCMN is the centralised platform for admissions to the MSc and MSc (Tech Programmes) at NITs, IIEST Shibpur, and some CFTI institutes that accept the IIT JAM scorecard. This year, CCMN counselling was conducted for three regular rounds and two special rounds for MSc admission across different participating institutes. Candidates preparing for NIT Durgapur admission can refer to the table below to view or download the year- and round-wise CCMN cutoff list.

NIT Durgapur also accepts DASA UG scores for BE/ BTech and BArch admission. Candidates seeking admission to NIT Durgapur can refer to the table given below to check out the DASA UG previous year cutoffs for the General category students:

Considering the last round of NIT Durgapur CCMT cutoff 2025, core M.E./M.Tech branches, including Computer Science and Engineering and Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, witnessed higher cutoffs for admission, while branches such as Microelectronics and VLSI and AI and Data Analytics in Process Engineering had comparatively relaxed cutoff scores for admission in the General category under the AI quota.

reviews.review_heading: Highlights of the National Institute of Technology Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: The academic infrastructure is strong with reliable labs and library access. Hostel life is manageable. Though food quality could be improved, the sports culture is vibrant, and a medical facility is provided. Basic support of the National Institute of Technology.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very satisfying and has good placements for all branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the hostel, it is not available in classrooms. There are AC classrooms. There is no problem with Airtel net, it is available in labs, classrooms, and hostel. 3 members per room. A large central library with thousands of volumes is available as a resource.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and placement opportunities with support.
reviews.review_text: The ECE department has a well-equipped campus and a central library with a wide range of technical resources. The hostel provides 24/7 water and electricity, though the mess food is average. Medical assistance is available on campus, and student assistance is available on campus. Students have access to various sports and recreation facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with college faculty members and there are good placements.
reviews.review_text: We have no Wi-Fi in addition we have jammers to block the network. Labs are well-designed and maintained properly. Classrooms are really good with projectors including clear board, nice ventilation, and very comfortable. Library is also very good having many books.

reviews.review_heading: As in every college, there is something that you will not like, but you have to take.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well maintained here at NIT Durgapur, I must say, all facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, library, and more than what we expect. In my hostel, we got three-seater rooms, but they are spacious and you will definitely love your big room. Washrooms are also well maintained, they keep them clean on a regular basis. Water cooler on each floor, you will have both options for normal water and cold water. Mess food is good, seriously, I personally feel it is good, you can eat it...

reviews.review_heading: My college life and my 4 years.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure for my course is good. My course is Electrical Engineering, and the department is good. The lab infrastructure is also very good, and the hostel is very good. The mess food is good but very much. In my college, we have a sports complex which is good.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Durgapur College review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our department are good. We have Wi-Fi and the lab equipment is in great shape. Our classrooms are clean, spacious, and equipped with projectors. The library is huge with over 200,000 books. The medical and sports facilities are top-notch. The hostels are a bit old and not great for second-year students but they are okay for most others. The food in the mess which I will honestly rate a 2 out of 5.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life with strong extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: NIT Durgapur offers modern infrastructure with smart classrooms. Wi-Fi-enabled labs, a central computer center, and a library with print and digital resources. The campus is 187 acres with advanced research facilities like Utkarsh Bhawan. Hostels provide basic furniture, LAN/Wi-Fi, and common areas. Newer hostels are better maintained, while older ones need renovation. Mess food is average, but canteens provide variety. Medical facilities include a 24/7 health unit with doctors, an ambulance, an...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Durgapur has a really good infrastructure when compared to others, and a decent one.
reviews.review_text: Hostel Wi-Fi is decent enough, and so is the hostel. You have to clean and wash your clothes all by yourself, because they charge a lot of money, like literally a lot of money, if you want to give clothes for cleaning. Medical facilities are good, and so are the sports and games. Mess food is too average and not many options are available, actually.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good and vibrant college life.
reviews.review_text: The hostel at NIT Durgapur is well equipped with all facilities. Mess food is good and hygienic. Laundry service is available on campus. The institute offers excellent sports facilities. Catering to a variety of games and encouraging an active lifestyle. Which is certainly good, but I think you will face some problems in adjusting.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and worth to join.
reviews.review_text: We have no Wi-Fi, in addition, we have jammers to block the network. The labs are well-designed and maintained properly. The classrooms are really good with projectors included, a clean board, and nice air flow through windows, it is very comfortable. The library is also good with books. They got more books than any college after Githam.

reviews.review_heading: The tale of a student - Good infrastructure, average faculties, good placements, good campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, I can say. Hostels, academic buildings, and labs are all fully air-conditioned and maintained, except for some of the labs, like the thermodynamics lab. Other core branch labs may not be that well-maintained, but the academic building is. Some classes in the main building don't have proper facilities. CS and hostels from the 3rd year are not so well maintained, but in the 1st and 2nd year, those are the best.

reviews.review_heading: The clear and complete review about 0 to 100 through this review.
reviews.review_text: Library contains maximum all type of books including course and exam syllabus related. Computer labs are newly constructed so they are in good condition. Wi-Fi is a non-wireless connection, and the speed is very good. Canteens are available around the college and inside the college too. The food is good but doesn't contain any spice or salt.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Durgapur honest review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are moderate. Hostel food is average for the money taken. But Wi-Fi connection is excellent. Classrooms are provided with air conditioning. Course is good. But the time we get for the semesters is very less to study. Overall, the experience is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, place for knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities for M. Tech students are honestly pretty good. We have 24/7 Wi-Fi in the hostel. One thing I really like is that M. Tech students get single rooms. Having your own space makes a big difference, it's peaceful, you can study whenever you want, and you don't have to worry about disturbing anyone. The rooms are clean, reasonably spacious, and regularly maintained.

review_summary.college_name: DY Patil University Pune Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Excellent and beautiful campus, with the best facilities. Placement needs improvement.

content.Placements: 65% of students are placed during the latest placement season. The recruiting companies are Adobe, Atlassian, TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google. The average package is 12.2 LPA. The top roles offered are software development, data science intern, machine learning intern, and web development intern.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-equipped labs specific to the course, such as regular lab upgrades are done based on industry needs. There are ML, IoT, Robotics, and Embedded Systems labs, with high-performance systems and licensed software. The college hostel rooms are good, and it is a beautiful campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The campus is awesome, and the faculty is good, but the only thing is that placement is not good.

content.Placements: In my college, out of 600 students, only 50-60 students get placements. The students who have a 9+ CGPA have been placed. The highest package is 12 LPA and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. The roles offered by the course are Developer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, ML Engineer, etc. Up to 90% have gotten an internship on the Edu Skills platform.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is the best. Entire campus have Wi-Fi networks, and labs are the best. Classrooms are also the best, and the library is average. The hostel is the best, but it is very costly. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and medical facilities are average. In sports, the university has a separate academy. The university's cricket ground hosts leagues like the Vijay Trophy, DY Patil Trophy, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is nicely maintained, but it can also be more upgraded in various fields.

content.Placements: The college has average placement and offers. The Corporate Relations and Career Services Cell, i.e., the T and P Cell, works hard to bring companies to the campus. They try to bring in more start-up companies, which makes it easier for students to get placed. The average placement CTC offered is 6–7 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided to students is quite good. Our college has multiple labs set up for students to study, which helps them grow their skills and gain experience in their particular domain. The hostel facilities are also available for students, located near the college only.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Graphic Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The campus is so peaceful.

content.Placements: I am a B.Des. in Graphic Design first-year student from D Y Patil University, Pune. There is no specific package to tell. It is all based on our skills, how we create it, and gain knowledge from it. Companies will hire us on the basis of our skills.
content.Infrastructure: The college has facilities like Wi-Fi, a good ambience, and tables according to our department, which are comfortable, so we can work properly. The hostel has Wi-Fi and a mess facility. The food in our mess is good. We do have other food items.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Graphic Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I love the campus, and it has the greenery.

content.Placements: I am a first-year B.Des student at DY Patil University. Placements are always based on our skills, but the college provides a lot of guidance to us. They offer plenty of skills and resources, so by the last year, we are fully prepared for placements with skills.
content.Infrastructure: The college is nice. We have a library, computer lab, and a workshop for working on models. The classrooms are well infrastructure, and the tables are according to the work, so they are comfortable. Both the hostel and the college have Wi-Fi. The food is good.

admission_process.title: DY Patil University Pune Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: DY Patil University Pune admissionsare primarilyentrance-based. The university accepts national or state-level entrance exams such as NATA,MHT-CET, CMAT, MAH CET, etc. for admission to specific courses. The university also conductsDYPCETfor admission to some of the courses such asBBA, MBA, etc. DYPU Pune offers a wide range of UG, PG, and doctoral programmes to students acrossEngineering, Management, and Science, among others.DY Patil Puneoffers courses through seven schools. Interested candidates can apply online on the official website of the university.

DY Patil University Pune is currently accepting applications for all courses. All the programmes are offered in full-time mode at UG, PG and doctoral levels. Below are keyDY Patil Pune admissionhighlights:

All the candidates seeking admission to DYPU, need to appear in an entrance test to secure a seat in their desired course. The seat intake varies depending on the programme. Programmes such as BArch have a very limited intake while a large number of students can be admitted to the BTech programme at DY Patil University. The table below shows the number of seats available for some of the courses at DY Patil University:
Note: Candidates must note that this information is sourced from the official website of the institute/university-sanctioning body and is subject to change.

The university offers admission both on an entrance and merit basis. Candidates have to get through all the selection rounds of the respective course to get a seat. The admission process involves application form filling and a selection process followed by counselling or an interview (for some courses). Below is the step-wiseDY Patil University Pune admission process:
STEP 1: DY Patil Pune Application Process 2025

The DY Patil Pune application process is carried out in online mode. Thus, aspirants can apply by visiting the official website of the university. The application process involves online registration, form filling, document upload, and fee payment. Candidates need to pay an application fee ofINR 800for UG and diploma courses. The application fee for PG programmes isINR 1,000.
STEP 2: Selection Process

DY Patil Pune accepts entrance exam scores for admission to most of the courses. The university accepts MHT CET, JEE Main, UCEED, NEET, etc. for admission to specific programmes. For UG, the candidates also need to qualify for Class 12. For PG courses, graduation in the relevant discipline is required. Candidates with the minimum qualifications will be eligible for admission. For the MBA, the university also calls candidates for the Written Ability Test and PI round.
STEP 3: Fee Payment & Admission Confirmation

The university releases a course-wise merit list on the official website of DY Patil Pune. Candidates who make it to the final selection list or are selected after counselling can pay the required amount of fee to confirm their seat. Also, the selected candidates have to submit specified documents for verification.

hostel.description:
D Y Patil University is residential campus. Accommodation is made available in three separate building in the campus for boys and girls, and has 1000+ capacity. For the food, campus has Legend Café managed by professional agency to cater the vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.  Hostel accommodation is allotted to students on First Cum First Service basis during the first year. The occupancy is single bed /double bed and triple bed and allotted to the students as per the availability.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent and beautiful campus, with the best facilities. Placement needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs specific to the course, such as regular lab upgrades are done based on industry needs. There are ML, IoT, Robotics, and Embedded Systems labs, with high-performance systems and licensed software.  The college hostel rooms are good, and it is a beautiful campus.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is awesome, and the faculty is good, but the only thing is that placement is not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best. Entire campus  have Wi-Fi networks, and labs are the best. Classrooms are also the best, and the library is average. The hostel is the best, but it is very costly. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and medical facilities are average. In sports, the university has a separate academy. The university's cricket ground hosts leagues like the Vijay Trophy, DY Patil Trophy, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college is nicely maintained, but it can also be more upgraded in various fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided to students is quite good. Our college has multiple labs set up for students to study, which helps them grow their skills and gain experience in their particular domain. The hostel facilities are also available for students, located near the college only.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is so peaceful.
reviews.review_text: The college has facilities like Wi-Fi, a good ambience, and tables according to our department, which are comfortable, so we can work properly. The hostel has Wi-Fi and a mess facility. The food in our mess is good. We do have other food items.

reviews.review_heading: I love the campus, and it has the greenery.
reviews.review_text: The college is nice. We have a library, computer lab, and a workshop for working on models. The classrooms are well infrastructure, and the tables are according to the work, so they are comfortable. Both the hostel and the college have Wi-Fi. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the Money and Average Placements.
reviews.review_text: Now, this is the good part, the hostel is good, and the mess facilities are decent at best. The workshop has all the basic equipment, but items used, like wood and thermocol, have to be supplied by students themselves, along with the additional cost and travel and arranging transport to bring them to the college workshop.

reviews.review_heading: A single floor college.
reviews.review_text: Food in canteen is decent, a bit pricey but okay. The hostel is strict and doesn't allow students to go out after 7:00 PM, forcing students to use canteen food for dinner that way. The area around the hostel is bad, crime rates are at the highest, and transport issues are there as it's in the middle of nowhere.

reviews.review_heading: Well balanced academics.
reviews.review_text: This place has a good hostel and mess. Wi-Fi has full coverage. Classroom, hostel, and mess are available. The hostel provides cleaning services. Gym facilities are only provided for boys, not for girls. There are cafes outside the campus and hostel students are not allowed to leave at 7:00 PM or return after 7:00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: Review for D. Y Patil University, Ambi, Pune.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi services are available full-time, and electricity backup is also there along with an abundant water supply. The hostel has three types of rooms single, double, and triple. Water coolers are placed on every floor in each building. Washing machines are available in hostels. There are two types of hostels old and new.

reviews.review_heading: If you have no option left and you think that you can study on your own. But, just need a degree.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, there's no doubt they have massive buildings. There are a total of 5 buildings, and all are above 7 floors. Classrooms are pretty huge, and they have a professional cricket ground. However, they lack auditoriums. The one we have is super small.

reviews.review_heading: Review of D Y Patil University, Pune.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are good. Rooms are spacious and have proper water and electricity supply. Rooms cleaning takes place regularly. Three types of rooms are available single, double, and triple occupancy. The hostel is maintained every year, and electricians and plumbers are available, with washing machine facilities also.

reviews.review_heading: I am not so satisfied with faculty members, and placements are not there.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus are pretty good and well-maintained. Wi-Fi facility is available, and there is a library and canteen are available. The infrastructure for the course is decent, not good, but there are huge spacious classrooms with proper ventilation and sunlight. However, desks are not good, and the seating is not proper. There is no proper management, no computer labs, and no proper facilities. However, the college has a cricket stadium, which is one of the biggest.

reviews.review_heading: A transformative college experience with strong academic and professional campus life.
reviews.review_text: Departments are offered well-equipped design studio, CAD labs, model making workshop, high-speed Wi-Fi, good library, and smart classroom. The library is stocked with design journals, books, and resources. Hostel facilities are clean, secure, and comfortable offering a peaceful environment for students. The mess provides hygienic food with decent variety. The canteen provides additional snacks. Medical facilities are provided on campus. Sports facilities are provided for both indoor and outdoor ...

reviews.review_heading: A transformative college experience with strong academics and vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are provided. Hostel is well maintained, but has a few restrictions. Canteen food is pretty good. Sports and games I am not really interested.

reviews.review_heading: Recommendations for a good architecture college.
reviews.review_text: New hostel block is completely good with all sorts of modern equipments. The cleaning and maintenance of the hostel is done well. There are options to choose from single, double, and triple sharing rooms. Wi-Fi and laundry facilities are also available at the hostel here.

Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology Warangal is a self contained residential campus located in a beautiful wooded land of about 248 acres. It is located near to Kazipet at a distance of 3 Kms from Kazipet Railway Station and 12 Kms from Warangal Railway Station.
faqs.question: Q: How can students reach NIT Warangal?

faqs.answer: Students are given admission in the MBA courses at NIT Warangal through Common Admission Test (CAT). Aspirants can apply for MBA with a valid MAT scores. A merit list is prepared based on the CAT Percentile of the candidates. NIT Warangal MBA admission is done through a merit list of entrance tests. Based on CAT scores, candidates are then called for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD & PI) round for final admission.
faqs.question: Q: How can I get MBA at NIT Warangal?

faqs.answer: To apply for the National Institute of Technology Warangal MCA course, candidates need to apply for the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET). Eligible students are then required to appear for the NIMCET entrance exam. Besides, aspirants must also pass a three-year bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate to apply for MCA programme.

content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings.

admission_overview.college_name: NIT Warangal Course Admission 2025: Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Application

paragraphs: NIT Warangal admission 2025is entrance-based. National Institute of Technology (NIT) Warangal offers a list of courses at the UG, PG and PG Diploma levels. BTech is the flagship programme of the institute. Admission to undergraduate engineering, i.e., BTech atNIT Warangalis depnds on JEE Main. Applicable students can apply by going to the verified website of the National Testing Agency (NTA). Different national-level examinations allowed by the institute areCAT, MAT, GATE, IIT JAM, and NIMCET.

Prior to applying forNIT Warangal course admissions, it is suggested that the students should check the eligibility criteria specified particular to the course. However, for the MBA course, group discussions and personal interviews are conducted.
NITWarangal Admission 2025: Eligibility & Selection

TheNIT Warangal admission processfor most of the courses is entrance-based. Hence, applicants must have a valid score on the respective accepted entrance exam. NIT Warangal accepts the GATE score for MTech admission. Admission to the flagship course of NIT Warangal i.e. BTech is offered based on JEE Main score of the aspirants. NIT Warangal fee structurefor all UG and PG courses includes components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, security deposit, and one-time fee payments. The components like tuition fees are charged annually or semesterly. In addition, it is within the rights of the institute to revise the fee structure. NIT Warangal UG and PG admissioninvolves an application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling. Aspirants have to go through each admission stage for seat allotment. The application form can be filled out online on the official website of the respective national-level exams. Find below the completeNIT Warangal admission process:
1: NIT Warangal Application Process

students seekingadmission at NIT Warangalare required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, students have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, students seeking admission to PhD courses are through the official website (https://nitw.ac.in/).
2: Selection Rounds

The institute admits students with a valid JEE Main score for BTech courses. students are further allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However,NIT Warangal MBA admissionsare done through the CAT/ MAT scores. Aspirants further need to come for the personal interview round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Warangal cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted students need to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.answer: Students are given admission in the MBA courses at NIT Warangal through Common Admission Test (CAT). Aspirants can apply for MBA with a valid MAT scores. Based on CAT scores, candidates are then called for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD & PI) round for final admission.

placement_data.title: NIT Warangal Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the placement report 2025 released by the Institute, NIT Warangal recorded placement rate of 79.3% in 2025 . The highest package offered during NIT Warangal placements 2025 was I NR 64.3 LPA . The average and median package received by students in 2025 was INR 14.35 LPA and INR 12 LPA , respectively. Further, 290 companies visited the campus ad 1225 offers were made as well.

Earlier, NIT Warangal highest package offered in 2024 stood at INR 88 LPA . The average package received by students during NIT Warangal placements 2024 was INR 15.6 LPA . The overall placement rate was 76%. More than 305 companies visited and 1,128 offers were made in 2024. A total of 1120 students were placed as well. NITK witnessed the return of the majority of past recruiters during placement drive 2023-24. There was also an increase in the number of new recruiters during this placement drive. IT sector emerged as the top recruiting sector that made 54% of the total full-time offers during the placement drive 2023-24. Top profiles in the areas such as Data Analysis, Software Engineering, Product Analysis , Consultancy , Management and Data Science were offered to students.

NIT Warangal has a dedicated Centre for Career Planning and Development (CCPD) that looks after all placement-related activities. Meanwhile, NIT Warangal placement process includes 6 steps. In the first step, invitations are sent to companies . In step 2 and 3, SPOCs are assigned to companies and placement drives are scheduled , respectively. The fourth and fifth steps includes Pre-Placement talks followed by tests and interviews . In the final step, shortlisted candidates get the offer letter from the respective companies.

reviews.review_heading: According to education it is good, but poor infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi good, labs okay, classrooms need improvement, and library excellent. Hostel contains better facilities, especially about food. NIT Warangal serves very quality and hygiene food, and also good in taste. Wi-Fi also gets everywhere in the campus and also good hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms in our branch department are very good and spacious. Wi-Fi is available in each classroom. Labs are well-maintained. The college library consists of more than 10 lakh books, which are open to everyone, and more than 10,000 e-books are also available. The hostels are good. The mess food is satisfactory. There is a food street as a canteen where we can get a variety of foods.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placement.
reviews.review_text: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a high-speed network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Some hostels are good, but we are not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room, not even the iron. The weather is too hot, and we are not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. The library is good with all types of books. Technology-based books are also available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Warangal is a good college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings...

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good vibes in the college.
reviews.review_text: There is a huge central library in the college which consists of almost every book possible. There are whiteboards and projectors in mostly every classroom. There are various societies and clubs. In the first year, there is a hostel named 1.8 K Ultra Mega Hostel, and the hostel room is not that big but fine for 2 persons. Quality of food is good; there is breakfast, lunch, and dinner there.

reviews.review_heading: Choose better college than this.
reviews.review_text: We have an auditorium where a movie is screened every week with a good sounding atmosphere. Infrastructure of hostel must be improved. The only problem is about washrooms. They don't even clean them properly. In hostel, two persons are adjusted in one room. Two beds and two study tables are provided. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for Mechanical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Hostel costs are affordable. There is an ethernet connection, electricity, fan, and cool mineral water in every hostel. The campus is very good. A big library is available for students for free. Good sports facilities and grounds are there. Gym is available for everyone. Many events and festivals are celebrated well. There are lots of clubs students can join to explore and learn. Gym is available. There are also coffee shops in campus, a food street where you can have food or buy necessary items...

reviews.review_heading: Good college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Some hostels were good but we were not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room not even the iron also the weather was too hot and we were not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Library was good all types of books and technology based books are available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely you can join this college.
reviews.review_text: NITW is known for its 1.8k hostel. It’s Asia’s largest hostel. The hostel facilities are very wonderful. They provide beds, fans, and lights. The mess quality is also good, but it can be improved. The mess menu should be diversified and should satisfy both North Indian and South Indian students. The vast library possesses excellent books which give students immense knowledge. There are also excellent sports facilities. There is a huge stadium. Students can also enjoy playing different games like...

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure covers all the basic needs: clean water, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for events, a playground for sports, and a well-stocked library. The classrooms are tidy, and there is transportation and on-campus housing for students who need it. The mess is clean and the food is decent, though a few more options would be nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal College.
reviews.review_text: On the downside, there are not really enough instructors, and the classrooms are well, they are pretty basic. The canteen menu is kind of limited too mostly just samosas and tea. The campus feels more like a place for cramming for exams rather than a real learning environment. There's no medical facility around. The hostel accommodation is not the best, but they offer some comfort. The mess serves hygienic food, and the water supply is pretty well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: NIT, Warangal is the best NIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are big enough. Classrooms are chilled with AC and fans. Library is also big enough. Hostel food contains variety of food daily. Canteen is also available. Medical service is for 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: College is a paved path, if you want a good placement, you have to run fast.
reviews.review_text: All over, the college is good, having a lush green campus and a nature-friendly environment,  Wi-Fi is available in the college, and in the hostel, we have LAN ports. Hostel rooms are good, with single and double occupancy. Mess food is good, it might vary from person to person, but for me, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Warangal College review.
reviews.review_text: The college has solid infrastructure with helpful amenities which is especially great for Science students. We have well-equipped labs and a decent library. For those traveling from afar, the hostel provides enough room. The mess is clean and while the food menu is alright. It would not hurt to add a few more options that students actually enjoy.

Candidates who have passed bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate can apply for SGT University MBA programme. SGT University offers the MBA programme with a specialisation in Fashion Management. Candidates who qualify the admission process can pay the course fee ofINR 3 lakh,the semester fee is INR 75,000.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MBA at SGT University?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to complete graduation with at least 50% aggregate to apply for SGT University MBA programme. Aspirants must hold the documents proving their eligibility for verification at the time of admission. MBA is a two-year course offered by SGT University.

faqs.question: Is CUET PG accepted for MBA at SGT University?
faqs.answer: SGT University accepts CUET-PG for MBA admission. Central University Entrance Test (Postgraduate) or CUET PG is an all-India level entrance exam, introduced for admission intoPG programmes in Central and participating Universities. The CUET PG exam consist of 100 questions and the question paper will be divided into two parts. Part A consisted of 25 questions on Language Comprehension/Verbal Ability and Part B consisted of 75 domain-specific questions.

faqs.question: Can I apply for an MBA at SGT University with a 60% in UG degree?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can get into MBA course of SGT University with 60% in the respective undergraduate course. As per the official brochure, the candidates with a valid bachelor's degree from a recognised university passed with at least 55% aggregate can apply. Aspirants must hold the pass certificate/degree with them as well. The documents are also required for verification purposes by the university during form filling and admission.

courses_data.name: SGT University BA Admission 2025
courses_data.description: SGT University offers a BA course for candidates at the UG level. Candidates wishing to secure admission to the course are required to participate in the merit-based admission process. The course duration is either three years or four years depending whether candidates wish to pursue the Hons. degree or not. The fee for each semester is INR 75,000. The course fee isINR 3 lakh.Candidates wishing to get admission must confirm their seat by paying the course fee.Candidates are required to appear for the Personal Interview round at SGT University to get the final admission offer.

faqs.question: How many seats are available for BA at SGT University?
faqs.answer: There are over 50 seats for BA programmes offered by SGT University. The seat allotment process is carried out as per the sanctioned seat intake and reservation policy of the university. There are 25% of seats reserved for students belonging to the state of Haryana at the university. Out of this,  10% are for students belonging to Haryana state SC category candidates. In order to secure admission in a reserved seat, the aspirants have to submit the relevant documents for the same.

faqs.question: How much does BA cost in SGT University?
faqs.answer: SGT University fee structureis cumulative of various components, such as tuition fee, refundable caution money and alumni association, hostel fee, etc. Some of these components are one-time chargeable, while some have to be paid annually/semesterly. The total tuition fee for the BA programmes range fromINR 3.9 Lacs to INR 4.5 lakh. This fee amount is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: Can I join SGT University directly?
faqs.answer: Candidates can join SGT University only after getting shortlisted for the applied course. The selection criteria varies course-wise. Candidates need to pass CUET-UG for admission to courses such as BSc, BCA, etc. For MSc, MBA, MTech, etc. aspirants require CUET-PG score. Besides, NEET conducted by NTA is accepted for BAMS and MBBS programmes. For all other courses, merit of the candidates is considered for admission.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to SGT University Gurgaon with 60% in Class 12?
faqs.answer: SGT University eligibility criteria varies course-wise. However, the aggregate requirement for most of the courses ranges between 50% aggregate to 60% aggregate. For bachelor's courses such as BTech, candidates need a minimum of 60% aggregate in Class 12.  Hence, candidates with 60% or more in Class 12 can apply for admission to any of the UG programmes.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for SGT University?
faqs.answer: SGT University admission process starts with registration for the preferred course. Candidates can fill out the application form offline or apply on the university website. SGT University selects candidates for most of the UG courses based onCUETscores. The university acceptsCUET-PGfor PG courses such as MBA, MSc, MPharm, etc. Besides, candidates must also fulfil the eligibility criteria to apply for admission.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to the SGT University BPharm course?
faqs.answer: The admission criteria for the BPharm course is merit-based. Candidates are shortlisted based on score in the last qualifying exam followed by a interview round. Moreover, the university may also accept CUET scores for selection. Before applying, aspirants must check out the eligibility criteria. The aspirants who are Class 12 pass with PCM/PCB subjects with 60% aggregate can apply. Additionally, applicants age must be 17 years or older on Dec 31. The eligible students can register and apply. After selection, the fee payment can be done for seat confirmation.

hostel_campus.college_name: SGT University Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The University has separate hostels for girls and boys with round the clock security arrangements, each hostels has separate dining rooms, recreation rooms and study rooms. The hostel rooms are very well furnished with beds, study tables, chairs and cupboards and equipped with ceiling fans and lights. Special facilities for air conditioners to be used on extra payment basis shall also be provided. Hostel accommodation shall be given for once a year instead one year commencing from the start of the academic year. All students enrolled with the university as regular students except ex-students are entitled to apply and be considered for hostel accommodation.CCTV surveillance in hostel areas. Dedicated wardens for each hostel.

library.description: The University has a fully air-conditioned excellent library with state of art facilities and with a huge collection of latest books and journals, national and international and other learning resources, both in print and electronic forms. The library has been carefully designed to have more space and natural lighting for the comfort of readers. It can accommodate more than 450 students at a time. It covers an extensive set of features with a simple user interface. The reference section includes a vast collection of reference books, handbooks, dictionaries, encyclopedias, CD-Roms on varied subjects such as Medical Sciences, Dental Sciences, Allied Health Sciences, Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Humanities, Literature etc. Central Library with 100,000+ Books, E-books, and Journals.

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Tennis Court

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, but Wi-Fi doesn't work in some places. However, the Wi-Fi network is good in the library and labs. There's also a hospital to perform or teach practical things to students so they can become good doctors. Placements are provided mainly in good hospitals.

reviews.review_heading: SGT University review in my opinion.
reviews.review_text: The campus is nice. There are food courts. Hostels have good rooms. They have a maximum of 4-B.Ed sharing with box beds and almirahs. Also, some food courts deliver at the hostel gate. Facilities are good, food is also good (I mean, what more can you expect from a hostel). But, the feels, in my opinion, is a lot.

reviews.review_heading: SGT gives you wings and good friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. Labs, buildings, and cafés are in good condition. The whole campus is very big with a lot of green parks and gardens. Hostels have lifts and provide four-time meals with specific timings. Hostels also have a gym, table tennis, and some board games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I have a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite nice. Classrooms and corridors are well-maintained and clean all the time. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Each block has its own library. It is quite peaceful place to spend study time. The hostels have strict security and maintain privacy. All other facilities are adequate.

reviews.review_heading: Take admission in SGTU, Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good and they provide buses for day scholars. Wi-Fi is provided but jammers are sometimes present. Hostels are clean, and food is edible. The library is well facilitated. There is even a book fair for you to buy books. Library has most of the books available but if you want to buy any of them, we have a supplier who comes every year. You can also participate in events of other faculty members which gives you a chance to experience their student life for a day...

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good. There is a centralized AC; also, the hostel has AC. Their labs, classrooms, and library are of first-class quality. The food at the mess is A1, and the sports facility is also good. A medical facility is obviously provided as they offer medical courses and have a hospital too.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very nice with AC, Wi-Fi, a library, and good classrooms. I have not opted for a hostel, but it is also good, as I have seen it. When I took part in fests, I have seen the hostel and many student reviews are good about that. The food quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Self and overall development.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. Sometimes the wardens get rude and don't inform things on time, but otherwise they are completely okay. The food is good; different items are made for variety and are eatable. Medical facilities are fully provided as the college has a hospital.

reviews.review_heading: University boasts a team of highly experienced and supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Campus facilities are impressive. The library is digital, but students also have the option to visit and study there in person. There is free Wi-Fi throughout the campus. Hostel food is considered better than what is typically found in other colleges, and the medical facilities stand out as the university has its own hospital. In addition, there is a strong emphasis on sports and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: The university faculty is highly experienced and helpful.
reviews.review_text: The university library is digital, and you can also go to the library. Free Wi-Fi is available. The food in the hostel is very nice compared to other colleges. The medical facilities are very good; the university has its hospital. Also, the university focuses on sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college organizes a great Holi fest, and has really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch. Washrooms are so clean, and they have pads in them. We have Wi-Fi, personal labs, and a library. Hostels are also good. The quality of food is very nice, and we get fresh fruits and homely food. We have to pay Rs. 20 as a token of money if we want to see a doctor in the hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and facilities.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there are full facilities of strong high-speed Wi-Fi and all subjects like Agronomy, Entomology, Horticulture, Seed, and Soil labs. In our college, all the classrooms have working ACs, and the library has books of all authors and subjects.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a decent college if you have money.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are fully air-conditioned with projectors. Labs are equipped decently, especially anatomy and pathology. Wi-Fi is available, but the speed can be slow sometimes. The library is spacious and quiet with good study material. Hostels are average with both AC and non-AC options. Washrooms are attached, and cleanliness is okay. The mess food is repetitive and not very tasty, but edible. Medical services are available on campus 24/7. There's a basketball court and a gym, though not very well...

reviews.review_heading: The college is full of memories.
reviews.review_text: There is a great infrastructure in our college. There are practical labs for research work. Unlimited Wi-Fi is available for students. There are classrooms with smart classes for presentations. The library has all books for the welfare of students.

college_info.college_name: SGT University Scholarship Details

paragraphs: SGT University offers scholarships to meritorious students in the form of fee concessions at the time of admission and in subsequent years. Candidates of UG (except for the Faculties of Medicine & Health Sciences, Dental Sciences, Indian Medical System) and PG courses are eligible for 20% to 100% fee concession based on their merit scores. Apart from this, SGT University offers additional scholarship benefits to students under specific categories.
DFP-Banner
SGT University offers merit-based scholarships to the students of UG and PG courses. The details of all the scholarships offered to the deserving students are given below:

The scholarships will be admissible to students of UG courses (except for the courses offered under the Faculties of Medicine & Health Sciences, Indian Medical System, and Dental Sciences) on a merit basis. Scholarships for the students of lateral entry will also be awarded as per the same criteria.

Criteria: The percentage for the scholarships will be calculated under PCB/M/CS and English as compulsory subjects or the best of four subjects with English as one of the compulsory subjects. Subsidiary subjects like Drawing, Music, and Physical Education will not be considered for calculating the percentage. The criteria for these scholarships are mentioned in the below table:
Scholarship Eligibility
Scholarship Amount (in %) for PG candidates
90% and above
75% and above but less than 90%
60% and above but less than 75%

The scholarship will be given to the courses offered under the Faculties of Commerce & Management, Behavioural Sciences, Nursing (including NPCC), Physiotherapy, Allied Health Sciences, Mass Communication & Media Technology, Education, Law, Fashion & Design, Agricultural Sciences, and Science. Candidates pursuing MSc (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Environmental Science), Medicine & Health Sciences, and SGT College of Pharmacy will not be considered for these scholarships.
Criteria: Merit in the last qualifying examination i.e. the UG degree will be considered for the award of scholarship. The criteria for these scholarships are mentioned in the below table:
Scholarship Eligibility
Scholarship Amount (in %) for PG candidates
90% and above
75% and above but less than 90%
60% and above but less than 75%
Alumni students with 50% to 60%

Apart from merit-based scholarships, students can also avail of SGT University scholarships under other categories like Defence and girl students. Mentioned below are the category-wise scholarships offered at the university:
1. Girl Students:
-Up to 5% concession on tuition fee for girl students of non-medical courses is awarded by the university
-Students of MBBS, BDS, BAMS, MD, MS, MDS, BASLP, Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology, PhD., MPhil, D.Ed. Spl. Edn., and B. Ed. Spl. Edn. will not be considered for this concession.
2. Siblings of students:
-Siblings of university students are eligible for a fee concession of 35% per year
-Awarded to studnets of all UG and PG courses except Medical, Dental, Nursing, Pharmacy and Ayurveda
3. Relatives of the university employees:
-Only the candidates related to university employees by blood (son/ daughter) or husband/ wife are considered
-Students of BSc Nursing (Post Basic) are eligible for 25% tuition fee concession every year
-For all other courses (except Medical, Dental, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Ayurveda), fee concession of 35% is awarded
4. Defence Category:
-Boy/ girl students whose parents are retired or serving in Defence (Army/ Navy/ Air Force/ Para Military Forces)
Candidates applying for scholarships under this category, need to submit several documents. Documents required in case of both serving and retired Defence personnel are listed below:
(i) Dependent’s card issued to the servicemen/ certificate issued by the Unit Head/ C.O. of the servicemen
(ii) Discharge certificate of the servicemen (applicable under retired Defence personnel category)
(iii) ID card of the servicemen/ ex-servicemen (whichever is applicable)
(iv) ID/Aadhaar card of the student
4. Principal’s reference
Boy/ girl students of various courses are admissible for 5% fee concession on the reference of the principal

SGT University offers up to 25% scholarship in subsequent years in the form of tuition fee concession based on the student's performance in the semester/ annual examinations (as the case may be). The award of scholarships to students will be continued after the third semester based on the criteria mentioned below:
75% or above aggregate in the previous year's final examination
80% or more attendance in all subjects of the course including practical (wherever applicable)
Cleared all the dues and paid the whole course fee for the particular semester/year
No involvement in any act of indiscipline, ragging, eve teasing, etc.
Not availing any other scholarship from any other Govt./ Govt. organisation/ Institute
Submitted the Scholar Project in consultation with their respective Dean/Faculty member

review_summary.college_name: NIT Silchar Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Beautiful college with good faculty, nice people of Assam, zero ragging, and good sports facilities.

content.Placements: I don't have an idea about how many students get placed, but it is more than 85 percent in electrical engineering, as they go to the core sector and the non-core sector. I do not have an idea about the highest and the lowest packages. Top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Infosys, and Cognizant. I do not have an idea about internships. My course students become electrical engineers, and if they go to non-core sectors, then they can become software engineers.
content.Infrastructure: Usually, our phone's internet will not work as well as it does in a Tier 1 city. It provides LAN, which has high-speed, so we can enjoy the internet. Classrooms are okay. It has Asia's largest library. Labs are good. Food is good, as we get both vegetarian and non-vegetarian canteens, so we can enjoy. Medical facilities are available in a hospital. There is a SAC building with a badminton court, so we can learn. To play table tennis, we can go to the sports complex. There are very good sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It offers good education and facilities. Placements are better for non-core roles.

content.Placements: 50-60 percent of students got placements in the civil course. The highest package offered last year was 19.90 LPA, and the lowest package was 4 LPA. The average package offered ranges from 6-7 LPA. The top recruiting companies in our course are L&T Construction, Tata Projects, NCC Limited, etc. 70-80 percent of students got internship opportunities. Top roles offered in our course are site engineer, design engineer, quality control engineer, planning engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. There is a civil lab in the department building and many classrooms. There is a central library which is open from 10 AM to 8 PM. The quality of facilities in our hostel is average, as there are few indoor games and an old building. The quality of the mess is not good in our hostel. The canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities in college are good as they provide the necessary medicine when needed. There are two grounds and many courts that cover almost all sports, and sports facilities are good with respect to other aspects.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My review about this college.

content.Placements: There is a placement cell which invites a lot of companies and firms for job opportunities. There are also opportunities for those who are willing to be an entrepreneur because students and the college also organize many times of hands-on workshops, research projects, and internships, as well as eminent scientists and professors talk to encourage students. So many companies come to recruit people. Internship fairs are organized by the placement cell of our college, and they recruit students from all courses. Packages vary from company to company, maximum being 12 LPA, and minimum 4 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Fees are lower compared to other NITs.

content.Placements: Placement of our college is really amazing as compared to all the NITs in India. As this year is 2025, the highest placement stood at 96 LPA from the mechanical engineering department, which is really a great thing. Also, the average placement of our college is 13 LPA, which is really good.
content.Infrastructure: I really loved the playgrounds, as these are huge, and also the inter-branch competition, which is held every year, is very exciting. The hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is average but adjustable. There is 24/7 internet, no issue with that. The bathroom is well furnished, and housekeeping is really good. They come every morning and clean the staff. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open for 24 hours. There are many grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college and the surroundings are also very good.

content.Placements: In the B.Tech Mechanical Engineering course, around 75–80 percent of students get placed in the latest placement drive. The highest package offered is around 18 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is nearly 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Tata Motors, Mahindra, L&T, JSW, Cummins, Vedanta, Infosys, Wipro, and TCS. Nearly 60 percent of students receive internships, with companies like Tata Steel, JSW, IOCL, HPCL, and L&T offering good opportunities. Top roles offered are Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET), Design Engineer, and Production Engineer.

paragraphs: NIT Silchar course admissionsare entrance based for all courses offered by the institute. The mode of application atNIT Silcharis online. For admission toEngineering courses, students need to qualify JEE Main and GATE entrance exams. Further, forManagementandSciencestream courses, the institute accepts valid scores of CAT/ CMAT/ MAT and IIT JAM, respectively.

Admission to allNIT Silchar coursesis only granted to candidates who are eligible under the set criteria for their chosen course. Such candidates can apply for the relevant entrance exam by visiting their official portal. Candidates need to follow the steps mentioned below to complete the NIT Silchar admission process:
1: Registration for Admissions

The NIT Silchar application process begins with the registration of the candidate for the relevant entrance examination. To register for the accepted entrance exams for NIT Silchar admissions, candidates must visit the official portal for such exams and follow the instructions of the announcement circular. For PhD admissions, candidates are required to register on the official website of NIT Silchar.
2: Selection Rounds

NIT Silchar selects candidates during admissions based on the relevant entrance exam scores. The relevant entrance exam is different for each course. For its flagshipBTech course, NIT Silchar admits students with a validJEE Mainscore. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is throughGATE, followed byCCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission,IIT JAMandCCMNCounselling are required. However,NIT Silchar MBA admissionsare done through theCATscore, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Silchar cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, forMBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats at NIT Silchar.

reviews.review_heading: Beautiful college with good faculty, nice people of Assam, zero ragging, and good sports facilities.
reviews.review_text: Usually, our phone's internet will not work as well as it does in a Tier 1 city. It provides LAN, which has high-speed, so we can enjoy the internet. Classrooms are okay. It has Asia's largest library. Labs are good. Food is good, as we get both vegetarian and non-vegetarian canteens, so we can enjoy. Medical facilities are available in a hospital. There is a SAC building with a badminton court, so we can learn. To play table tennis, we can go to the sports complex. There are very good sports fa...

reviews.review_heading: It offers good education and facilities. Placements are better for non-core roles.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. There is a civil lab in the department building and many classrooms. There is a central library which is open from 10 AM to 8 PM. The quality of facilities in our hostel is average, as there are few indoor games and an old building. The quality of the mess is not good in our hostel. The canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities in college are good as they provide the necessary medicine when needed. There are two grounds and many courts that cover almost ...

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is different for different hostels. There are 9 hostels for boys in this college and 3 hostels for girls. Mess and canteens are present in every college and have a quite amount of seats, so every student can sit here at one time and eat. Bathrooms are present in sufficient amount. You don't need to take tension for infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Fees are lower compared to other NITs.
reviews.review_text: I really loved the playgrounds, as these are huge, and also the inter-branch competition, which is held every year, is very exciting. The hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is average but adjustable. There is 24/7 internet, no issue with that. The bathroom is well furnished, and housekeeping is really good. They come every morning and clean the staff. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open for 24 hours. There are many grounds for different...

reviews.review_heading: The college and the surroundings are also very good.
reviews.review_text: The campus is beautiful, surrounded by greenery and lakes. This gives a calm and refreshing vibe even during stressful exam weeks. The infrastructure is pretty good. It includes well maintained hostels, labs, and sports facilities. The Wi-Fi sometimes tests your patience, but that is part of the fun here.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the placement record in the last 3 years.
reviews.review_text: NIT Silchar was built on a total of 625 acres. A nature-rich campus with more than 20 lakes and 2-3 gardens. Classrooms are digitalised. The infrastructure for the CSE course is good, labs are well managed, and a LAN (Ethernet) is provided to every hostel room. Hostel maintenance is above average, and there are 9 boys' hostels and 4 girls' hostels. Food quality is good, and our college has a good sports management team. We have a dispensary clinic in the college itself.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with staff members.
reviews.review_text: The university covers an area of 15 acres. The building is well-designed and maintained. The classrooms are designed with 4.0 teaching technology and also provide Wi-Fi facilities in every class and hall. The hostel also provides good facilities like fresh food, gym, Wi-Fi, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good college as a NIT and good placement +.
reviews.review_text: NIT Silchar EE department has decent labs and LAN access, but classrooms lack modern facilities, and teaching quality varies. However, hostel life is vibrant and enjoyable with good mess food, clean rooms, friendly environment, and making campus life memorable.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: College faculty is very good and interested in learning. The chemistry lab is also in campus, which is very clean, and there are many chemical products that help in learning more about it. Exams are also held on campus and are subjected to classes. There are 9 hostels for boys in this college and 3 hostels for girls. The hostel infrastructure is good. Mess facilities, TV room, sports room, and good spacious rooms are there. And it is also very cheap. There are single rooms, double rooms, and tri...

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Course is pretty good and has a lot of focus on practical learning. Every semester, there are 2-3 laboratories of 2 credits each. The institute has taken many research initiatives and has a separate research and innovation cell for these activities. I have opted for and been allotted a hostel since the first year. I got a hostel room which was initially for PG students, so the rooms are great. I got a double room in the 1st year. The rooms and facilities are excellent. Mess food is compensable. ...

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: I have opted for a hostel which is compulsory in our college. I share my hostel room with a fellow colleague of mine. Rooms are quiet with a 24-hour electricity supply. There is a bed, a table, a chair, a wardrobe, and a balcony in the room. The lighting condition is also quite good. The hostel rent is Rs. 15,000 per semester.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Silchar is good in placements and campus life. City life is poor, that's all.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the hostel and the infrastructure of the Electronics and Instrumentation branch are very good, even EI is known as the coolest branch of NIT Silchar. The food quality of the hostel is above average.  Canteen is good but a little bit cheaper, and vegetarians may face problems.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The quality is not top-notch but the basic facilities like clean drinking water clean washrooms and a bathroom are available, the food qualities are not too bad it can fill your stomach for the 3 times of the day and the snacks are available the canteen foods are good. For the medical facilities. We have a dispensary where basic medicine is available and for the sports. We have football and cricket grounds for the outdoor games and for the indoor games, we have a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placement ratio in 2025.
reviews.review_text: All classes are digital classrooms. Labs are decent. My department is very good, with enough instruments available for experiments. The Wi-Fi provided by the library is good. However, we have LAN in the hostel, and we don't have a Wi-Fi connection. The mess food is average. There is a medical dispensary right next to the girls' hostel. The sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: This is my short review of my campus, NIT Silchar.
reviews.review_text: They provide excellent Wi-Fi, lab, and classroom facilities along with good freedom, but hostels are a bit average. Hostels are built like those from the 80s and 90s, which makes your room feel old. Until the fourth year, you don’t get any privacy in your room as only triple-sharing rooms are allotted.

review_summary.college_name: SJCE Mysore Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sri Jayachamarajendra College of Engineering, JSS STU.

content.Placements: Good companies do come for placements, and it is the single best pro of this college. This year, the average package offered is around 11 LPA, with CSE leading in terms of employment and the highest package. The number of companies coming for internships is good. An ample chance is given for students to get internships.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is dirty and neglected. Cleanliness does not exist for the warden. Our college lab facilities are decent and well-equipped. Notably, the golden jubilee block is the best out of all. Sports facilities are good since the college is huge. An in-house gym is available too, which is free for the college students.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges in Mysore, if you are willing to do MCA.

content.Placements: According to my knowledge, in our MCA batch, around 80-85% of students were placed through campus placements. The highest package offered was around 12.4 LPA, while the lowest was 3.5 LPA, and the average package stayed around 5-6 LPA. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, LTIMindtree, Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, and Bosch. Nearly 60% of the students also got internships in companies like TCS, Infosys, startups, and analytics-based organizations, mostly in roles like software development, web development, and testing.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college for engineering.

content.Placements: Our college placements are pretty fine, with more than 60 percent of students getting placed in their final year. A huge number of companies come for recruitment and offer a good package for students. The minimum package offered is 3 LPA, and the maximum package offered is 55 LPA. TCS is the major recruiter.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent here, and the students have a good environment for studying. A good number of playgrounds are present for sports. I am not a hosteller, so I do not have a good idea about hostels, but its good. Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: An excellent college and a good presentation.

content.Placements: In my college, almost 70% of students get placed and get hired by the companies that pay more than 15 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. The company includes Schindler Electric, Quest Global, Mercedes-Benz, Infosys, Oracle and TCS, etc. TCS hire a lot of students from our college.
content.Infrastructure: Buildings are huge and available for almost 500 students. Hostel facilities are kind of good, but the food facilities are at an average level. They have park grounds and fitness and physical facilities. Our hostel is eco-friendly projecting various plants and wildlife.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am really satisfied with my college.

content.Placements: The college placement of the total number of students at a place was about 70%. The company that recruits the highest number of students is TCS. Internship offers were made by Lams Industries and Quest Global. Many other students who have gone for paid internships have been absorbed in the same companies.
content.Infrastructure: I also live in a hostel that is inside the college, and the food provided is okay, kind of average and the rooms are pretty clean. The Wi-Fi provided here is pretty fast, and there is also a garden, and playgrounds are provided for students to play. And all the labs are well-equipped with new equipment and study materials.

admission_overview.college_name: SJCE Mysore Admission 2025: Courses, Fee, Eligibility & Application Process

paragraphs: SJCE Mysore admissionis entrance-based. The college considers national or state-level entrance exams for admission. Sri Jayachamarajendra College of Engineering (SJCE), Mysore is an autonomous institution underVTU Belgaumand governed by the grant-in-aid rules of the Government of Karnataka.SJCE Mysorehas earned a reputation for being one of the best engineering colleges in Karnataka, offering over 30 UG and PG level courses across various Engineering disciplines. Additionally, it also offers PhD programmes across all the departments. Its flagship course is Bachelor in Engineering (BE). More details about theSJCE admission criteriaare provided in the following sections.

Apart from the exam score, it is also crucial that the applicants fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria for selection. It is the educational qualification required for a candidate to become eligible for admission. Moreover, the college may conduct a common admission test for admission. Check belowSJCE Mysore coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
