*In the absence of information, the data is taken from an unofficial source.

The seat allotment for this college is through the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA). When the seats are left vacant, then those are filled out by the institute. SJCE Mysore fee for each course includes multiple components such as tuition fees, security deposit, and more. After the seat allotment procedure, for admission confirmation, students are required to pay the admission fee. The following table mentionsSJCE Mysore feesand seat intake:
NOTE:The above-mentioned fee is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

The seat intake varies course-wise at SJCE. Candidates need to pass the accepted entrance exam and fulfil the eligibility requirements to get a seat in the college. Below is course-wise intake for SJCE:
NOTE:The above-mentioned seat is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

SJCE Mysore UG and PG admission processis entrance-based. Thus, aspirants need to have a valid score in the accepted exam for the desired course to take admission. The entrance exams accepted by the college are KCET/ COMEDK UGET/ PGCET/ GATE can apply. The stages of the admission process are explained below step-by-step:
STEP 1: SJCE Mysore Application Process 2024

The first step is that the aspirants check the course-specific eligibility requirement and then fill out the admission form. SJCE application form can be obtained from the campus or students can apply through the KEA official website (kea.kar.nic.in).
STEP 2: Shortlisting of Students

KEA further shall release a cutoff list for the courses. Candidates with a score equal to or more than theSJCE Mysore cutoffcan take part in the counselling. For the BE course, the Karnataka Examination Authority allots seats for 95% of aided courses and 50% for unaided courses.
STEP 3: Admission Counselling & Confirmation

Students further need to participate in admission counselling to get a seat. Selected candidates further have to appear at the college and submit important documents for verification and pay the admission fee to confirm their candidature.

faqs.question: What is the admission process at SJCE Mysore?
faqs.answer: SJCE Mysore course admission is entrance-based. Candidates are thus required to have a valid score in the respective entrance examination such asKCET/COMEDKfor BE,PGCETfor MBA, MCA, and MTech. Moreover, the students must meet the course-specific eligibility criteria for selection.Eligible students can register for the desired course by filling out the application form. The admission form can be obtained from the KEA official website or in person from the institute campus. Moreover, seat allotment is carried out by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA).

faqs.question: Does SJCE Mysore accept KCET score?
faqs.answer: Yes,Sri Jayachamarajendra College of Engineering considers KCET score for admission to its BE programmes. The seat allotment is carried out mainly by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA). Further, KCET is also conducted by KEA and is a national-level examination. It is conducted for admission to the Engineering colleges in the Karnataka state. Moreover, apart from exam score, selection also depends upon the fulfiment of the course-specific eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Does SJCE Mysore offer admission under Management Quota?

admission_overview.college_name: IIFT Kolkata Admission 2025: Fees, Cutoff, Eligibility, Application Process

paragraphs: Admission to IIFT Kolkata is entrance-based. The institute offers Management courses at postgraduate, certificate, and PhD levels. IIFT Kolkata accepts students based on their performance in the accepted entrance exam along with other selection parameters. The institute accepts valid scores obtained in national-level entrance exams. MBA in International Business is the flagship course of IIFT.

Shortlisting for the full-time flagship MBA in IB at IIFT Kolkata is based on the entrance exam. The final selection, however, depends on Essay Writing, GD, and PI rounds, conducted by the institute. For other courses, admission is either entrance or interview-based. Students can also choose to pursue a degree inMA Economicsat this institute. The selection criteria differ according to the course selected by the candidates. Interested students can refer to the table below to learn about the eligibility and selection criteria for some of the courses of IIFT Kolkata:

Course fees vary according to the programme selected by the students. Candidates are required to pay the fee at the time of admission to confirm their seat. The fee is inclusive of several components, such as tuition fees, admission fees, etc. Some components need to be paid one-time only while others need to either be paid semester-wise or yearly. The admission process involves multiple steps, starting fromthe application. Students seeking to apply for the courses offered at IIFT Kolkata must appear and secure a valid score in the accepted entrance exam. Additionally, they should meet the parameters decided by the institute prior to applying for admission to the course. Interested students can refer to the following steps to complete theIIFT Kolkata admission process:
Step 1: IIFT Kolkata Application Process

Aspirants can visit the official website of IIFT Kolkata and register themselves by filling out the registration form available on the website. The registered candidates can then fill out the application form and pay the application fee to confirm their application.
STEP 2: IIFT Kolkata Selection Process

IIFT will shortlist candidates for MBA (IB and BA) programmes based on CAT scores from the 2024 admission year. Earlier, admission was through the IIFT exam. For other courses, such as MA and PhD, the institute shall continue to conduct entrance exams. Only the candidates shortlisted based on the accepted exam score become eligible for participation in the next selection round.
STEP 3: Selection Rounds

ForIIFT Kolkata MBA course admission, shortlisted candidates have to go through WAT, GD, and personal interview rounds. The interview round is further conducted for admission to all the programmes, except for MA.
STEP 4: Release of Merit List/Cutoff
After all the selection rounds, the institute may release a selection orIIFT Kolkata cutofflist. This list carries the names of all the selected candidates who are eligible for admission.
STEP 5: Admission Confirmation

Candidates who make it to the final selection list become eligible for admission. Such candidates can pay the required amount of fee to confirm their admission. The institute might carry out document verification before the final seat allotment.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA in IB at IIFT Kolkata?
faqs.answer: The total fee for MBA in International Business at IIFT Kolkata is INR 20.97 lakh. This fee is inclusive of components, namely tuition, library, internet, medical insurance, course material, hostel charges (for double occupancy, boarding charges, students and alumni activity. The students of SC, ST and PWD categories are given 50% concession in the tuition fee. If the student opts for single or triple occupancy accommodation, the aforementioned fee will vary. Having said that, this fee was for the academic year 2022-23, the exact amount of the total fee applicable for the MBA (IB) 2023-25 batch is only informed to the students when they are provided with the offer letters.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at IIFT Kolkata?
faqs.answer: The highest (domestic) and average package offered during IIFT Kolkata MBA IB placements 2023 stood at INR 76.5 LPA and INR 29.10 LPA, respectively. Furthermore, the highest (international) and median package offered was INR 85.4 LPA and INR 26.50 LPA, respectively during IIFT Kolkata placements 2023. A total of 108 companies visited the campus and many top recruiters visited the campus such as TATA Steel, Deloitte, Loreal, Flipkart among others. Similarly, the highest, average and median stipend offered was INR 4.40 lakh, INR 2.63 Lacs and INR 2.50 Lacs during summer placements 2022-2024 batch. A total of 100 companies and 36 new recruiters visited IIFT Kolkata campus. The stipend was offered for a period of two months.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the placement and infrastructure, etc.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are also modern. Classrooms, library, and labs are also very good, and in every class, air conditioning and a projector are available. The quality of food is good. Hostel facilities are separate for boys and girls. Sports and recreation facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the nature of teachers and the infrastructure of classrooms.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connectivity and my department is not good. In labs, there are falls of air conditioning. In the labs, there are two laptops for PCs and they don't work. The library of my college is good or not excellent. The food available in my college is good. The food items and the menu of my college canteen are limited.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best B-schools in India.
reviews.review_text: It is located in the business hub of Salt Lake. IIFT Kolkata campus is compact but well-equipped. It offers all essential facilities like a well-stocked library, computer labs, Bloomberg terminals, and high-speed internet. While it may not be a sprawling green campus like some other institutes, it makes up with efficient infrastructure and proximity to the city's commercial centers, which help students in terms of guest lectures, industry exposure, and live projects.

reviews.review_heading: Higher grade college in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Campus located with the acres of ground which were more spacious and relaxing. All the juniors, Seniors were more friendly, supportive and encouraging like the teachers. And chances for ragging, harassment was literally zero percentage. Uninterrupted network connectivity inserted in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our university is one of the best universities in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Our college is equipped with good infrastructure. There are around 3 libraries and labs are well-equipped with all necessary instruments. Classrooms are well maintained and have all facilities. There are around 2 boys and 3 girls hostel. Food is very hygienic and good quality and they serve breakfast, afternoon lunch and dinner.

reviews.review_heading: IIFT to an amazing experience and learning.
reviews.review_text: Very good infrastructure. Everyone has a separate room. My room had a balcony also. Everyday maid comes and cleans. It is located outside the city so its calm. No outside food is readily available as located very far off from the city. One mall is there called acropolis.

reviews.review_heading: It is a place that provides excellent placements, great faculty and amazing campus to MBA students.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has a sprawling campus of about 6 acres which houses top quality classrooms, a 500-seater auditorium, an open amphitheatre and library. Being a fully residential campus, it has a state-of-the-art hostel facility with round-the-clock staff for cleaning and maintenance. The hostel also houses a mess, a cafe, a utility store and a laundry service. Food provided in the mess is as good as in all B-schools across India. The only lacking aspect of infrastructure can be attributed to less amount of...

reviews.review_heading: A college with good placement opportunities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus at Kolkata is very new, and the infrastructure is very good. It is a Wi-Fi enabled campus and is equipped with modern classrooms and a state-of-the-art auditorium. There are a gym and other facilities available for sports and games as well. The hostel has single occupancy rooms, and it creates an environment that is conducive to learning.

reviews.review_heading: Students get diverse opportunities at IIFT.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has two beautiful campuses in northern Delhi and eastern Kolkata of the country. Both the campuses have an excellent hostel, library, auditorium, and ancillary facilities. IIFT, Kolkata has a single occupancy hostel which is an added advantage.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with my experience at IIFT.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and the classroom infrastructure is new. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. The library is huge with all the books related to the course, and there are books related to other genres too. The hostel rooms are well-equipped with furniture, and there are single occupancy rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: With a batch of around 120 students and a brand new campus, infrastructure is never an issue at IIFT Kolkata. Although, there is a lack of sports facilities. However, the gym and indoor gaming facilities are excellent. The ambience in campus is peaceful and beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: Placements for summers and finals are good. A serene campus to live in with an exceptional pedagogy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Kolkata campus is like a resort with many amenities. The library is well-stocked with the books of all domains. The classrooms are well-maintained to give you a professional feel of MBA which is a huge upgrade that you might have had in your bachelors. Our college has three beautiful lakes, a centralised air-conditioning system, a huge auditorium with all technical facilities of sound projectors, etc. There is a digital room which you can utilise for availing computer facil...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides an amazing environment for students.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided the most common and useful facilities like 24X7 Wi-Fi. There was a digital library that had the best use. Labs were great and very useful in visualisation. Classrooms WEre soundproof and good. Food and medical facilities were top-notch. The playground was huge and we had good sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides great placement opportunities and decent campus life.
reviews.review_text: The campus of IIFT Kolkata is a newly built campus with almost all the facilities. Classrooms are properly furnished and completely air-conditioned. There is a decent library with a lot of books and Bloomberg terminals. The hostel is one of the finest compared to other B-School hostels, and all the rooms have single occupancy. One thing which the IIFT Kolkata campus lacks is a proper sports field.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are really good. Only the mess fee is not included in the fee structure. The hostel fee for the 2-year course is 1 lakh. Hostels are well-designed. There is a 24x7 electricity and water supply. Rooms are on a twin-sharing basis.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: Amity Global Business School Bhubaneswar offers a wide range of programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. The college is mainly concerned with the Management stream. At the UG level, the college offers a GPBA+BBA programme to students for a duration of 3 years. After completing this course successfully, students will receive a GPBA certificate from AGBS Bhubaneswar and the fleximode BBA from Amity University.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) + Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Amity Global Business School, Bhubaneswar.

review_content.Placements: About 55% of the students got placed in the college. The highest salary package offered was 4.5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Redington, Kotak, Ceasefire, Talent corner, Ajio and Bajaj visit our campus for placements. About 10-20% of students got placements in companies like Swiggy, NALCO and Mswipe. MBA and BBA courses are offered in the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. It does not have a parking facility for vehicles. There are no labs and Wi-Fi facilities. Classrooms are small here. There is no hostel facility for students. The quality of food served is very poor. There are no medical facilities. There are no mess and canteen. There are no playgrounds for sports and games.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) + Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Everything is good here, and faculty members are also good.

review_content.Placements: Almost 100% of the students in our course got placed. The highest salary package offered in our course is 12 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA. BBA and MBA programmes in our college are good.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Classrooms are comfortable and air-condtioned, and there is no disturbance in the classroom. The library is good with Wi-Fi facility. Labs are not available on the campus.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers in our college are good, helpful and supportive to every student. They use all languages, but while training students, they used only the English language. All faculty members are qualified. It offers a good atmosphere. They are active anytime and teach in the best way.

reviews_list.batch_info: GPBA + Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2017
reviews_list.review_title: The college has excellent faculty members and exposure.

review_content.Placements: Placements are good enough to cover ROI, but better opportunities can be looked after. The college invites companies, but the selection depends on students performance in interviews. There are different industry sessions organised by the college. People from highly reputed corporate companies visit the college and give lectures which are very helpful for students to improve their network.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is small. However, it is still at a development stage. Amity, Bhubaneswar is not able to develop better infrastructure due to certain government and law restrictions, but they make sure that both students and faculty members don’t miss out on quality experience despite limited facilities. Infrastructure doesn’t matter if the quality of education is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) + Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2017
reviews_list.review_title: Review

review_content.Other: Even though the campus is small no doubt faculty is too cooperative. The atmosphere is friendly. Basic facilities are available. College is not up to the mark as the name suggests. No personal hostels available. No transportation facilities available by the college. No cafeteria. Very small campus. Flexible rules. Good for below average students. No on-campus Placement drive. No internal exams. Only assignment presentation. Class time is from 9 a. m. to 6 p.m., very hectic life.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) + Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Very satisfied because of the faculty but the infrastructure is not that satisfying.

review_content.Placements: There are 58 students in my class. 10,00,000 is the highest package of salary that one of my seniors got. The packages range from 4 to 7 Lacs. Flipkart, Sri ram, Justdial, Zomato etc. are the companies that recruited college students. 95% of students got internships from our college. It's a good college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided here is not that good. They just have a building in the name of infrastructure.
review_content.Faculty: The teachers are really helpful. They are qualified enough to train us in a good manner. They are highly qualified and knowledgeable. My mentor is a very soft-hearted person. She supports me so much. The curriculum is relevant and it makes us ready for the industry and the corporate world.

reviews_list.batch_info: GPBA + Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It provides an exceptional environment for students to learn with supportive faculty.

review_content.Placements: For BBA, the college doesn't provide any placement, but still, the placement cell guides us. For MBA, placements are there and assure 100% placement assurance, and the placement cell always helps you through this. The average package for an MBA graduate is around 10 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel is more like a PG, it is a rental house in which each room has 4 beds. It is well facilitated but not up to what they had promised earlier, like providing washing machines, rent of 5000 which includes electricity, and so on. But overall, it depends on the student.

paragraphs: Refer to the pointers below to know how to apply for admissions at AGBS Bhubaneshwar:
1. AGBS Bhubaneswar Application Process
Amity Global Business School application process is conducted both in online and offline modes. For complete the application form online, students can go to the college's official website.
2. Selection Round
Candidates who clear the application process have to appear for a PI round and an English proficiency test.
3. Release of Merit List

Those students who clear the selection round, can find their name in the AGBS merit list. This list has the minimum score required in the exam and the interview for candidates to qualify for admission. Aspirants meeting or surpassing the cutoff marks move on to the counselling round.
4. Counselling

Students who have their name in the merit list are then required to take part in the counselling round. The institute verifies candidates' documents and allocates seats on the basis of merit, eligibility, and performance in the interview and English test.
5.Admission Confirmation
Candidates are required to pay the fee to confirm their admission for their assigned seats. This final step completes the enrollment process.

reviews_list.review_title: It has good and eco-friendly infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: The college provides placements in various companies, such as Air India, etc. Packages offered are different for students from other states, like 3-4 lacs for management studies like BCA, BBA, and B.Com. BBA Aviation is the main course in college. Some subjects like cloud computing, AI, logistics, and supply chain management courses are also available in this college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite good and mainly eco-friendly. It has a quiet place, and each department. It has different buildings, like management studies in one building, another for nursing, etc. Each course has a separate building. The campus provides free Wi-Fi for students and staff members. The hostel food is not good. They support us in sports activities and events. They always try to conduct that.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: A college where you can learn and enjoy.

review_content.Placements: Around 30 to 40% were placed in my college. The highest package was around 6-7L, and the lowest was around 2-3L. Almost 95% of students got internships from my college. I have no idea about the top role offered, but one of my friends got placed in a high role, like he got a permanent job.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is cool. It's so big. The lab systems aren't too bad, but we don't have Wi-Fi. Classrooms are big and clean. The library isn't quite up to the mark, it's not that helpful.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, but the students, no one attended the class properly. Teachers are double-graduated. They have high knowledge. The course curriculum is relevant, it makes the students interested in it. The exams are too easy, they ask direct questions, and the passing percentage is 40%.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Review About East West College of Management .

review_content.Placements: The percentage of students getting placed here is 2-5%. The highest is 3.5 LPA, and the lowest is 2-2.5 LPA. IBM and CAPGEMINI have visited, but about 0-2% of students got internships. Associate trainee and training-level jobs were available from the companies that came to this college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure in this college are not good. There is no proper smart class for students, and there is no Wi-Fi facility. The library is like a class godown, and the classroom infrastructure is also not good. The hostel is also not good; students constantly complain about the food daily and also about proper hygiene.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Good college that is enjoyable .

review_content.Placements: I've studied MCA at East West College of Management Studies, Bengaluru. It's not a good college; better opt for other colleges just to have fun. You can join no proper placements and events just for money; they're getting admissions. If your motive is to get placed, don't join this college.
review_content.Infrastructure: There's no Wi-Fi or washing machines in the hostel. There are two hostels: one with three shared rooms and another with 8 rooms sharing a common bathroom on one floor. It'd be better if they provided Wi-Fi and washing machines. There is no good food; only Malayalam students are more.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2017
reviews_list.review_title: I think, if you are looking at every scenario, then you will get better college than this.

review_content.Placements: Not even a single company visited for placements. We almost waited all our three years. At least, we could have some interview knowledge, but no companies headed. So, please don't expect any placement, if you are a degree student. For engineering, there maybe one or two companies as I have seen.
review_content.Infrastructure: As we look up for the campus, it is good. I am sure that the students nowadays loom for the better campus, and this will be the choice you may be looking for. But the campus is not huge, it will be manageable. What all you need, you will see at this campus. I personally tell you, this college has a good campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: There are no great placements in this college.

review_content.Placements: This college is not good for placements. During my period hardly many companies came to campus. 2% of people were placed during our course. The highest package offered was 4LPA the least was 2.5LPA. TCS application link was forwaded to us for application.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent and the library is maintained very well. But the lift is always under repair. There is no Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are quite huge. The men's hostel is inside the campus and for women it's a half a kilometre walk. The food of hostel is not good.

reviews.review_heading: It has good and eco-friendly infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good and mainly eco-friendly. It has a quiet place, and each department. It has different buildings, like management studies in one building, another for nursing, etc. Each course has a separate building. The campus provides free Wi-Fi for students and staff members. The hostel food is not good. They support us in sports activities and events. They always try to conduct that.

reviews.review_heading: A college where you can learn and enjoy.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is cool. It's so big. The lab systems aren't too bad, but we don't have Wi-Fi. Classrooms are big and clean. The library isn't quite up to the mark, it's not that helpful.

reviews.review_heading: Review About East West College of Management .
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure in this college are not good. There is no proper smart class for students, and there is no Wi-Fi facility. The library is like a class godown, and the classroom infrastructure is also not good. The hostel is also not good; students constantly complain about the food daily and also about proper hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Good college that is enjoyable .
reviews.review_text: There's no Wi-Fi or washing machines in the hostel. There are two hostels: one with three shared rooms and another with 8 rooms sharing a common bathroom on one floor. It'd be better if they provided Wi-Fi and washing machines. There is no good food; only Malayalam students are more.

reviews.review_heading: I think, if you are looking at every scenario, then you will get better college than this.
reviews.review_text: As we look up for the campus, it is good. I am sure that the students nowadays loom for the better campus, and this will be the choice you may be looking for. But the campus is not huge, it will be manageable. What all you need, you will see at this campus. I personally tell you, this college has a good campus.

reviews.review_heading: There are no great placements in this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent and the library is maintained very well. But the lift is always under repair. There is no Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are quite huge. The men's hostel is inside the campus and for women it's a half a kilometre walk. The food of hostel is not good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities and infrastructure available for our courses like labs classrooms and a library.

reviews.review_heading: Review of East West Group Of Institutions, Magadi Road.
reviews.review_text: Good quality of infrastructure was provided, and separate blocks depending on the courses and offices. Grounds and parks, and canteens were available. Xerox facilities were inside the campus, along with a personal college bank branch. There was an indoor court for badminton, table tennis, caroms, chess, etc., which were always open for the students. Hostels were available and food quality was average.

The MAT 2026 Feb session registration is open. For PBT mode, the last date to register is Feb 23, 2026, and the test is scheduled for Mar 1, 2026. Further, for CBT mode, the registration closes on Mar 2, 2026, and the test will be held on Mar 8, 2026.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: School of Management, Ajeenkya DY Patil University offers diverse programmes at UG and PG levels in Full Time mode. The offered programmes can be chosen from streams such as Business & Management Studies, IT & Software and Accounting & Commerce. At the UG level, candidates have the provision to opt from courses such as B.Com, BBA and B.Com (Hons). Whereas, at PG level, School of Management, Ajeenkya DY Patil University offers courses such as MBA/PGDM and MCA. School of Management, Ajeenkya DY Patil University fee structure for all the courses is around INR 2,34,668 to 7,00,000.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: The university provides us with good career guidance.

review_content.Placements: The university is well known for its placement activities, with a dedicated placement cell that actively connects students with potential employers. It also provides career guidance and personalized counseling to help students identify a suitable career path. The highest package offered was ₹1.2 crores, and the average package was ₹6.5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our university boasts a 100-acre campus with modern infrastructure, including a cafeteria, medical facility, physical and digital libraries, well-equipped seminar halls, classrooms, a cricket ground, labs, design studios, and conference halls. The campus also features a cafeteria for student dining and a medical facility to cater to student health needs.

Some safety measures and emergency equipment were set up in a college as a precautionary measure. Also, some students from the other states were studying here, and they were helped with the required needs.

individual_reviews.title: Strong placements and a great place to learn.

content.Placements: The placement cell at our university is quite proactive. It starts preparing us from the third year itself with aptitude training, mock interviews, and resume-building workshops. For our course 85 percent of students who opt for placements get placed successfully. The highest package offered is around 18 LPA from a major product-based company while the lowest is 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has modern classrooms equipped with smart boards and projectors. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with decent speed, which is a great help for research and project work. Labs are excellent. We have specialized labs for various domains, including an Apple Lab for iOS development, a Data Science lab with high-end systems, and robotics labs. The central library is huge and well-stocked with a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources.

Some safety measures and emergency equipment were set up in a college as a precautionary measure. Also, some students from the other states were studying here, and they were helped with the required needs.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is around the mountains which creates a great atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: It has a great campus life as we see the sunrise and sunset in the mountains. The climate is very nice in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I liked the campus and location of the college.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 types of hostels in college: 80000, 135000, and 150000, each differing in the facilities they provide. However, the college hostel doesn't provide food. Currently, I am living in a PG where I pay 9,000 per month for food. To register for a hostel, one has to go to college and apply for it.

reviews.review_heading: The worst college Never ever take admission to this college.
reviews.review_text: The worst infrastructure, Situated in a village where the surroundings are not safe, For girls, it is very unsafe. Never takes admission. Village people always bother and disturb you. Goons are everywhere. Be careful before taking admission. If you have a strong political background, then only you can survive.

reviews.review_heading: Highly recommended MCA college.
reviews.review_text: There are some issues with the college's location, which is far away from Pune and Pimpri Chinchwad city. Only locals and buses are available, as the public transport metro is not reachable. College give good facilities yes Wi-Fi is available. The labs and the college campus are kept clean. Classrooms are very big. Yes, we have our own hostel, and the mess rooms are newly built. The food is vegetarian, except for Sundays.

reviews.review_heading: Gain knowledge, get placed.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very beautiful; all things look brand new. We have a big ground on campus and also an indoor sports room where carrom, table tennis, and chess are played. Wi-Fi speed is high and available throughout the campus. Our classrooms are big, equipped with projectors and mics. I have not stayed in the hostel, but my friends told me that they have good food and accommodation. Fire extinguishers and first aid kits are placed everywhere in college for safety.

reviews.review_heading: I really love and miss my college.
reviews.review_text: The campus of Ajeenkya DY University is very big; greenery is everywhere, and the college is newly built. The library's seating arrangement is good, but during exams, it gets overcrowded. The college organizes expert talks, visits, and seminars for students' development. We have boys' and girls' hostel rooms which are big; one room is given to three students. The mess food is fine; only one kind of curry is served many times. We have many canteens; they have AC, TV, and good food.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is worth the money paid.
reviews.review_text: The campus is huge and green. It has a great environment. The infrastructure of our college is good. Hostels are expensive. They are neat. Our college does not provide transport facility.

reviews.review_heading: The campus, infrastructure and curriculum are all excellent.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided are innovative & updated with the latest technology. There are more than 3 canteens and cafeterias, students have free access to Wi-Fi and there a multiple IT Labs for students to access any information needed. The Library is very well-versed with diversity of books, novels and magazines. There are separate hostels for males & females and the mess food has a lot of options to choose from. There a lot of clubs to volunteer in like Theatre & Art Club, Sports Club, Marketing...

reviews.review_heading: Good college and faculty present in the campus.
reviews.review_text: ADYPU has almost every facility you can think of, including hostels, mess, canteen, medical facilities, and sports ground for each sport. The college has both girls and boys hostel providing good hostel accommodation for students. Classrooms are excellent with comfortable benches. Every classroom has a projector so that the students can gain practical knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: DY Patil University is a place to become perfect.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms were spacious and comfortable for students. All the classrooms have a high-speed internet facility to make sure all students access it and are up to date. All the labs were of high end, and the needful software was provided for students to be ready.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are very nice and helpful. They guide every student and pay proper attention.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is amazing, and the facilities are also good. The library is also good. Other than that, many education programs are available. Our college recently arranged an international paper presentation, which was very helpful.

faqs.question: Is direct admission possible in Banasthali University?
faqs.answer: Bananasthali Vidyapith course admissions to all courses is both merit and entrance-based. The university offers admission to various UG and PG courses. The university conductes Banasthali University Aptitude Test for admission to selective courses such as BTech, MBA, BSc Nursing, LLM, etc. There is no way to get direct admission to these courses. Admissions are solely based on entrance exam. However for courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, etc.,. There is no requirement to qualify for any entrance exam. Candidates are only required to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria and fill an online application form. Based on the past academic records of the applicants, the university will select the right candidates.

faqs.question: What are the courses that Banasthali Vidyapith offers?
faqs.answer: The university offers 15+ undergraduate courses in the disciplines of Mathematics, Science, Management, Commerce, Arts, Engineering, Aviation, Education, Design, Law, and Journalism. It also offers 60+ masters and 25+ PhD courses in the disciplines of Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Education, Commerce and Management. The popular courses of Banasthali Vidyapith are BTech and MBA. These courses are offered across various specialisations. Admission to most of the courses at Banashtali Vidyapith is entrance-based. Whereas, for other courses, candidates are selected based on their previous merit scores.

faqs.question: What is the last date for Banasthali Vidyapith admission form?
faqs.answer: Banasthali Vidyapith admissions are currently open. The university usually releases the admission form in April. Since admission to some of the courses is entrance-based, the university also releases the dates for the aptitude test. The university conducts Banasthali University Aptitude Test in June for different courses.

faqs.question: Is there direct admission for MBA at Banasthali Vidyapith?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission at Banasthali Vidyapith for MBA programme the students have to clear Banasthali University Aptitude Test. Only based upon the latest educational qualification, a student cannot reserved a seat for MBA at Banasthali Vidyapith Jaipur.

reviews.review_heading: This is best in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of B.A. in this University is very good. There are many facilities so I can easily pursue this course. There are many facilities provided by this University like all-time Wi-Fi facilities for the students. The University classrooms are fully air-conditioned and there are many hostels in this University because no day scholars are allowed, where students live together. There are many extra facilities available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our 850-acre residential women's campus hosts 25,000 students with elite sports and vibrant fests.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are far better than those of other semi-private colleges available in India. The quality of hostels is very good, the food was also better, and with a variety on each weekday. If we talk about sports facilities, they are outstanding, the trainers are very good in nature, and they provide students with quality time and guidance.

reviews.review_heading: This university is one of the best in Jaipur
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is very good. The university occupies a lot of area. It provides many facilities, like Wi-Fi available all the time in the hostels and departments for students and faculty, so they can easily learn what they want. The classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and the library is very big and provides many opportunities for students. There are many hostels for students who live on campus. The university also has food and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are few, and fests are boring. Other activities are nice.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi in the hostels is fine but only available at certain times. You can only be connected on your laptops. Labs are above average but again no Wi-Fi. Classrooms don't have AC but the new departments are very modern and aesthetic. There are libraries in almost every department while a central one is also available.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

The food quality in this university is also very good. The university conducts many fests every year.

review_content.Placements: The average package offered is about 4 to 5 lacs per annum. (Maximum of sales jobs are offered). Rarely you get an opportunity for core marketing and finance jobs. reviews_list.batch_info: Graduate Diploma in Business Administration (GDBA) + Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019

review_content.Placements: BBA students often apply for placements through the placement cell in college. Good companies like Facebook, Deloitte, KPMG often come to the campus for placements. reviews_list.review_title: Review

paragraphs: Amity Global Business School Hyderabad admission processis a multi-step process, which includes application form filling, application shortlisting, selection rounds, and seat allotment. Before applying for the course, candidates must go through the eligibility criteria. The final seat allotment is done after candidates successfully go through each of the stages in the admission procedure. For the aspirant's reference, the step-by-step process is mentioned below:
STEP 1: AGBS Hyderabad Application Process 2026

Amity Global Business School accept application in three ways: online, offline, and by buying an application pack. To submit the application form in offline mode, candidates can download it from the official website and submit it with a DD of INR 500 in favour of the 'Amity Form' payable at New Delhi or pay with a credit card/debit card. The application pack form can be submitted to the respective campus. Moreover, the online form can be filled out through the school's official website.
STEP 2: Shortlisting of Candidates

AGBS shortlists candidates based on their marks in the last qualifying examination. Further, the candidates also need to appear for English Essay Test followed by a personal interview round. The final selection is done based on qualifying exam marks, and performance in the selection rounds.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation
Selected candidates further have to deposit the important documents and pay theAGBS Hyderabad fees. After which, they can report to the institute on the prescribed date.

paragraphs: Amrapali University Haldwani admissionis strictly based on the eligibility criteria of the courses, which are defined by AICTE, UGC, and Affiliating Universities. The Amrapali University is a private University approved by AICTE. It offers full-time undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in engineering, hotel management, applied sciences, and management. The application process for Amrapali University courses admission is conducted online on the official website of the University. Candidates must meet the eligibility criteria before applying for admission toAmrapali University.
The various courses offered by the Institutes are affiliated with Uttarakhand Technical University, Kumaun University, Uttarakhand Open University and Uttarakhand Board of Technical Education.

Amrapali University offers admission to various UG and PG courses. The duration of UG courses is three years and PG courses are two years. AU Haldwani also offers Diploma courses as well. The eligibility criterion for all UG is Class 12th from any of the recognized boards and eligibility percentage with age set by authorities of AU Haldwani. The Amrapali University admission process consists of multiple steps that include the release of application forms followed by the shortlisting of candidates based on merit secured in the qualifying exam. The selection criteria for all Amrapali University courses is merit-based. Interested candidates can check the below steps for the Amrapali University admission process:
Step 1: Amrapali University Application Process
Candidates who meet their desired course's eligibility criteria must fill out the application form before the deadline. The forms are made available on the AU official website.
Step 2: Amrapali University Selection Rounds
The University shortlists candidates based on the merit secured in the qualifying exam. After shortlisting candidates, the University releases a merit list on the official website.
Step 3: Amrapali University Final Admission

college_info.intro:
SIMS Pune offers an MBA as its flagship course. This course is available mainly for defence personnel and their dependents only. However, some seats are reserved for civilian candidates. For the Open category, 10% of seats are reserved for civilian candidates (as per merit). At the PG level, SIMS Pune offers two-year MBA and 30-month Executive MBA programmes. The MBA is a full-time residential programme with minor and major specialisations in Marketing, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, HRM, and International Business.
The Executive MBA is a part-time degree programme with classes on weekdays (evening) or weekends. Executive MBA is offered in five specialisations and the college also offers MDP programmes to the students. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by SIMS Pune and their respective eligibility and fee:

The mean packages provided to the top 10 per cent and 25 per cent students in 2025 were INR 17.5 LPA and INR 15.5 LPA at that, respectively. The recruiters that participated presented the job roles in different fields, such as BFSI, Consulting, IT/ITES, Business Analytics, FMCG, Manufacturing, Telecom, EdTech, and many others. The leading recruiters who would visit Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies campus to carry out the 2025 placements would be Accenture, AON, Apollo Global Management, Axis Bank, Bajaj Finance, Bank of America, Barclays, BNY, Cognizant, Crisil, Deloitte etc.

paragraphs: SIMS Pune admission process includes SNAP Test, SIMS Selection process, Merit list, and Final Seat. Find below the step-by-step SIMS admission process :
Step 1: SNAP Test

Candidates must apply for the Symbiosis National Aptitude (SNAP) Test, which is a common written test for admission to all Symbiosis postgraduate institutes. Candidates must visit the official website of SNAP http://www.snaptest.org and register. Simultaneously, register online to SIMS Pune by paying an additional INR 1000.
Step 2: SIMS Selection Process

SIMS will shortlist the candidates based on their SNAP score. The results are announced via a web-link on SIBM Pune's website as per the scheduled dates. Shortlisted candidates must fill out the online SIMS application form and participate in the SIMS selection process, which includes Group Exercise & Personal Interview (GE-PI). The SIMS selection process selection process will be held online.
Step 3: Merit List

The institution will finally release a merit list with names of candidates who have qualified for the selection process of SIMS Pune. Final Merit List (category-wise) is based on marks obtained out of 100 (SNAP - 50 marks, GE-PI - 50 marks).
Step 4: Seat Finalisation

Call letters for provisional admissions are sent as per the merit list and the remaining candidates are given a waitlist number. Candidates will receive an offer letter from the Institution, They must pay the tuition fee and confirm their seats in the institution.

facilities: Auditorium: Well-furnished and well-equipped auditorium, fully air-conditioned, seating capacity of 585 people, and a generator backup
Library: SIMS Pune has a big library which is 390.17 sq mt with a seating capacity of 96 persons. The library consists of three areas discussion area, a stack area, and a reading room

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi was available on the campus. Library was present on the campus. The quality of facilities available in the hostel was good. Basic facilities like fresh drinking water and clean washrooms were available.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Our course curriculum was very detailed and covered all the important subjects and courses in management. Since the MBA programme was for two years, in the first year we studied common subjects that were the same across all specializations, and in the second year, we studied specialized subjects. Hostels were neat and clean, with two boys or two girls accommodated in each room. Parking space was available under each hostel building. The mess food was neither very good nor very bad. There was a l...

reviews.review_heading: Professors teach what market needs and always pushes to upgrade ourselves.
reviews.review_text: I availed for the hostel accommodation because I wanted to save my time as well as my money. Hence, during the time of admission, I paid Rs 31,200/- as the first installment. Apparently, I paid Rs 31,200 as my 2nd installment. The place was good as well as safe.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with everything.
reviews.review_text: First things first, look, feel and the vibe of the campus are surreal. In the single day itself, you witness different sessions, from bright mornings to heavy downpours during the evening chilly winter. SIBM offers a variety of clubs and special interest groups in which you can be part. The library is big; it is at the heart of the academic block on the on the ground floor of the library is accessible 24 hours a day. Students have a choice of taking 2 or 3 sharing rooms. Hostel rooms are spaciou...

reviews.review_heading: One of the finest colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: Symbiosis has a central library portal that is open for students. Faculty and researchers provide vast database of research. There are many areas on campus to play basketball, cricket, football, swimming, etc. SIMS have 10+ team cell like event cell, sports cells, and branding cells. In hostel, students offered clean four-sharing room with attached facilities. The mess menu is changed every week. Its annual fee is 60,000/-.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in the world.
reviews.review_text: The campus at SIMS was fantastic, filled with fun and assignments. There were lots of annual fests and discussion panels. The campus has a good library and various amenities like a gym, swimming pool, and canteen. The hostel facilities were very good, with nice and clean rooms accommodating three people. The canteen offers a variety of good food and snack options.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts world-class infrastructure, offering a very friendly campus environment. With 13 campus committees, students have ample opportunities for engagement. Wi-Fi is available during college hours. The hostel provides all the necessary facilities. Sports enthusiasts will be pleased to know that we have green fields for cricket, football, volleyball, and more. Regular matches between classes add to the sporting atmosphere.

reviews.review_heading: Enjoyable Campus Life at College.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are well-maintained, accommodating three students with separate washrooms, almirahs, and study tables. The mess provides hygienic and quality food. Hostel fees are INR 60,000 per year, with external expenses ranging from Rs. 2,000 to Rs. 4,000.

reviews.review_heading: Make your career with Symbiosis.
reviews.review_text: College is famous for its world class infrastructure. Classrooms are designed in a modern way. Library has all the kind of books. Hostel has good food, sports, gym, etc. The food quality of mess is good but canteen's food is better than mess. For sports, indoor and outdoor sport clubs are there.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is worth spending two years.
reviews.review_text: SIMS had pretty much everything in terms of infrastructure. We had good classrooms, a huge library, and Wi-Fi across campus. There were no air-conditioners. Hostel rooms were spacious but you might have to share them with 2-3 students depending upon availability. Food served was the same as served by any other college hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place for budding entrepreneurs and students who aspire to get a good job.
reviews.review_text: Our institute has a well-developed infrastructure, along with a library, gym, swimming pool, canteen, medical aid and clean hostel facilities. Our college even has auditorium and quality mess facilities. Overall, the infrastructure is really attractive. In the hostel, 3 students are allotted in a room, but it is quite spacious.

reviews.review_heading: Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies is worth the money paid for the course.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available in college. We have Wi-Fi, well-equipped classrooms, and a library. Sometimes eating at mess becomes boring but they maintain a good quality of food for students. Each facility is available on the campus, and it's more of a second home to people here at SIMS.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides great ROI and is a special college for students of defence families.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is small but equipped with a gym, swimming pool and other amenities. As our college boasts 80% admissions to students of defence families, it has a military hospital and CSD canteens, which are almost available at the boundaries of the college. So, it is an advantage to students.

reviews.review_heading: Placements for 2019 were good. Great teaching methodology. Strongly promotes sports activities.
reviews.review_text: Food and infrastructure is really great, frequent maintenance and well planned infrastructure provides easy access to mess, canteen and medical facilities. They have well maintained basketball court, football ground and a clean swimming pool for sports enthusiasts.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for MBA with great ROI.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure as well as some open space and sports facilities. Wi-Fi is available in all the classrooms and labs. Other college facilities along with the Bloomberg terminal are also available. The hostels have a 3-4 sharing facility. Within the college, there is a basketball court, badminton court, gym facility along with trainers and a good swimming pool.

individual_reviews.title: All about Christ University, Pune, Lavasa.

content.Placements: Placements are being offered here, companies like South Indian Bank, Deloitte, Apple, TCS and many more offer on-campus recruitment for the campus. For my course, the mass hiring is basically by Deloitte for the role of Taxation, Financial Analyst, etc.

individual_reviews.title: Review of Christ - Lavasa, Pune Campus.

content.Placements: Specifically hire for various roles like research economics, financial analyst, investment banker, and data analyst, with the package varying between 3.6 LPA and 18.9 LPA for a year. Maximum chances for getting hired in various banking roles, with the college drive itself.
content.Infrastructure: Christ campus, which is richer in rules and norms, coordinates and assists the students to follow the same. Meanwhile, they strictly look for the students to be very punctual with proper dress patterns insisted on by the university. Food servicing is done with higher quality.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Data Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a highly disciplined college.

content.Placements: In the previous year, the average placement offers received by the students of Data Science doubled compared to previous years. The highest salary package is 27.5 LPA, which is double the package of previous years. Distinct companies look for students from our discipline.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are responsible for building disciplined behavior among the students. They even point out the smallest mistakes of the students. This activity is surely pressurizing, but it helped us achieve 100 percent academic results. It’s a deemed university with versatile features focused on providing standardized education to students. The university carries its own principles as its pride, and it’s essential to clear entrance exams for admission into any of the courses.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Business Analytics (Hons) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Christ University is a dream university.

content.Placements: 90-100% of students who opt for placements are placed. Highest package was 40 LPA, and lowest was 4 LPA, with an average of 8 to 11 LPA. Which also depends upon the stream. 100% got internships and 70% got PPO. Top roles are at managerial levels in business analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Christ has flats and villas as hostel in Lavasa campus, well maintained with all services. Cost of a hostel ranges from 40k to 1.5 Lacs. There is a dedicated boys' and girls' hostel where there is a Wi-Fi facility. Mess is not in hostel, it's in college. Which is also near hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best university for the MBA course.

content.Placements: The college has some good placements. Over 71% of MBA graduates obtain the highest salary of 27 lacs. The proportion of transfers to various branches is lower than that of the MBA. JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and HSBC are some of the leading recruiters. Management consultant and product manager were the most sought-after positions, among others. 65% of students secured their internships.

The library is very good. The roads are very good. Departments are centrally located throughout campus, and there are many free places on campus to hang out.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Insights of NIT Karnataka.

content.Placements: Nitk mechanical is the best among all NITs in the QRF ranking. It has a placement rate of about 85 percent. Major core companies that came for placements this year were Apple for mechanical with a minor in ECE, L&T, Bajaj, Suzuki, ONGC, and HPCL. IN 2025 the average package for mechanical is 15 LPA. Internship opportunities are abundant across branches with a stipend of roughly 20k to 1 Lakh per month and many PPOs.
content.Infrastructure: Mechanical depth of Nitk has one of the best infrastructures among all departments. It has all the research related facilities, specialized labs like CAD/CAM, Internal combustion engines, and advanced research labs in areas such as strength of materials, robotics etc. Hostels have double and triple sharing rooms with 2 common washrooms on each floor. Ethernet facility for the internet.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The course is very unique and offers good placements.

content.Placements: Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, HSBC, Wells Fargo, Arcesium, L&T, Amazon, and ExxonMobil were among the firms that visited. IT/Software firms paid an average of 14 LPA, with the maximum compensation being about 50 LPA. Many PSUs paid approximately 16 LPA for core roles. The management was also very supportive in providing placement training.
content.Infrastructure: In the hostel, all facilities were provided in the rooms. The rooms were spacious. First- and second-year students shared rooms with 2 or 3 people, and later they got single rooms. All types of sports like basketball, volleyball, cricket, badminton, swimming, and powerlifting were available. There were also many cultural and technical clubs, which won cups and prizes in competitions. The classrooms were spacious, with charging points and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus. Classrooms had proper smart boards, and some even had ACs.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Industrial Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good college, infrastructure, and placements.

content.Placements: From the 2nd semester, we are eligible to get internships, so along with many students, we can get PPO. The number of companies visited is all there on the NITK website, but placement is good. In my course, the highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. In my course, around 85-90 percent of students get placed. I wanted a job in a pharmaceutical company.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are top-notch, and all facilities, like projectors and smart boards, are available. The library is good, and all types of books and magazines are available. Hostels are good. There are 2-seated and 3-seated rooms. There are different grounds for different sports.

admission_overview.college_name: NIT Surathkal Course Admission 2025: Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Application

paragraphs: NIT Surathkal, the National Institute of Technology KarnatakaMBA 2025 application formis out. The institute select students based on national-level entrance test scores. Some of the accepted exams are CAT, JEE Main, GATE, etc. The mode of application is online. The institute offers a range of UG, PG, and doctoral courses in the streams of Engineering, Management, Computer Applications, etc.NIT Surathkal course admissions 2025will be based on various national-level entrance exam scores as per course requirements. The popular courses offered by the university are MCA, BTech, MBA, and MCA. NIT Surathkal also offer scholarships to support meritorious students and provide financial support.

The university offers courses in full-time mode over 15 courses. NIT Suarathkal offers more than 15 courses across various specialisations and aspirants need to apply for courses though the official website.

NIT Surathkal offers courses in the fields of Engineering,Management, Computer Applications,Scienceetc. Students seeking admission must meet the course-specific eligibility and selection conditions. The below-mentioned table carries course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for NIT Surathakal course admissions 2025:
Eligibility

NIT Surathkal fees for all UG & PG courses include components, such as tuition fees, hostel fees and one-time fee payments. Further, seats may vary as per the course type and number of specialisations available. Students can check the below table for detailed fees and seat intake for all the popular courses:
Note:The above-mentioned fee & seat intake details are taken from the official website/ sanctioning body and are subject to change.
Admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling. Find below the complete process around NIT Surathkal admission 2025:
1: NIT Surathkal Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Surathkal are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to MBA, courses must be required to apply through the official website.
2: Selection Rounds

For BTech course, NIT Surathkal admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly, for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Surathkal MBA admissions are done through CAT/MAT/GATE score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: Admission to the courses at the institute is entrance-based. The institute accepts national-level exam scores (for example, JEE Mains/GATE/IIT JAM). Aspirants can fill out the accepted entrance test application. Further, based on exam scores and performance in the round of counselling, seats are allotted to eligible students in NIT Surathkal. The application process for the popular courses offered by the institute are:BTech aspirants must fill out the application form for JEE Main through the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA).MTech aspirants are required to register for GATE through the official website of the GATE Online Application Processing System (GOAPS).For MSc admission, candidates need to apply to IIT JAM through the official website of the respective conducting bodySimilarly, for the MBA programme, candidates need to apply for CAT/MAT/GMAT on their respective conducting bodies.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

First- and second-year students shared rooms with 2 or 3 people, and later they got single rooms. All types of sports like basketball, volleyball, cricket, badminton, swimming, and powerlifting were available. There were also many cultural and technical clubs, which won cups and prizes in competitions. The classrooms were spacious, with charging points and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus. reviews.review_heading: Good college, infrastructure, and placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are top-notch, and all facilities, like projectors and smart boards, are available. The library is good, and all types of books and magazines are available. Hostels are good. There are 2-seated and 3-seated rooms. There are different grounds for different sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostels have facilities like Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. The classrooms are air-conditioned, and the central library is well-equipped for borrowing books. The mess food is average, but there are three canteens serving really tasty fast food. There is also a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Surathkal College.
reviews.review_text: Now, our course definitely benefits from some great facilities and infrastructure. The campus had a central library, Wi-Fi access, and digital classrooms, which was nice. The hostel accommodation was quite good, and the meals were pretty tasty, whether you were eating at the mess or the canteen. Don't forget the multi-sports complex!

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Suratkal
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Surathkal College Review.

The medical and sports facilities were pretty solid overall. The second year student hostels arena. It was the best, but the others were just fine. The food was decent, too.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Surathkal College review.
reviews.review_text: The campus includes all the essential academic and research buildings, a central library, well equipped labs, and classrooms with Wi-Fi. Students could use residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation was generally seen as satisfactory. The food in the mess was just average. It was a health center with medical professionals available, in case someone got sick.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a good college in order to learn, with better infrastructure and good placements in 2026.

Wi-Fi is pretty good, and labs are maintained and equipped with the latest machines. Classroom has good ventilation and proper spacing, with a smart board also. We also have 2 libraries, one of which is 24hrs open. Food quality in mess is normal, and canteen has good food also. We have a medical centre, also with all types of doctors available. We ...

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, with good facilities for sports and academics. LAN ports are available for connection to the public Ethernet, which is unlimited. Various events are well-organized on our campus, and different clubs provide different opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life with good placement and private rooms, a place like heaven for engineering.

faqs.answer: A:    For BBA, a passing score on the NPAT (NMIMS Programmes Aptitude Test) is required. For a B.Com., an NPAT score is required. faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MBA at NMIMS Indore?
faqs.answer: Aspirants should have a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in any field. The candidate should complete Bachelor's degree with a minimum cumulative score of 50% to get MBA admission at NMIMS Indore. While it is not required, having two years or more of post-qualification job experience may increase your chances of being admitted.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores does NMIMS Indore accept for admission to MBA?
faqs.answer: Only NMAT (NMIMS Management Aptitude Test) results are accepted by NMIMS Indore for admission to its MBA programme. It does not take into account the results of any other entrance exams, such as the CAT, GMAT, or XAT. One of the most significant considerations in the NMIMS Indore MBA program's selection process is your NMAT score. You need to receive at least 210–220 on the NMIMS.Verbal Communication, Quantitative Skills, and Logical Reasoning are the three portions of the computer-adaptive NMAT

faqs.question: What are the cutoff marks required for MBA at NMIMS Indore?
faqs.answer: Applicants having NMAT scores in the 80–99 percentile range are usually taken into consideration by NMIMS Indore. Higher scores within this range usually result into a higher selection chance. It also takes into account your undergraduate percentage in any discipline. A solid academic background can help your application, even though there isn't a minimum % requirement. Even with somewhat lower NMAT scores, candidates with solid professional histories might be selected for further consideration.

hostel.description: SNU provide an interactive, holistic, healthy and academic-oriented environment for students. Sister Nivedita University hostels are gender segregated and independent. The entire hostel facility is maintained by professional housekeeping and maintenance agencies that have vast exposure in the corporate climate. A global agency has been deployed for pest control and they work in defined periodic cycles, which is monitored and reported. This agency uses a combination of biodegradable and eco-friendly chemicals that does not impact our environment and is part of our commitment towards sustainability. A 24x7 security system, using male and female guarding staff, as appropriate, is deployed and very closely monitored by a vigilant and robust security matrix. Students from different cultures and backgrounds are treated with respect and dignity fueled by guidance and encouragement from the teaching team, as well as supported by excellent resources.

The major focus of the SNU library is to provide online/ digital learning resources that will allow users to access them anywhere, at any time. Apart from relevant text-books, a number of books of general value and interest are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with Industry exposure.

On campus, food trucks are there with lots of tasty and healthy options to choose from.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty, good infrastructure and facilities, satisfactory food.

Food trucks at the university offering a wide variety of options with quality above average.

Sports and games communities are there too, which organize many events and guide you for representing the college in AIU.

Classrooms are comfortable, spacious, and classes are easier to follow with the help of projectors and whiteboards.

b) Under this scholarship scheme, a remission of 50 % to 100 % of total fees is waived for needy students, and the candidate should maintain a good academic record per semester.
Note: Chancellor Merit cum Means Scholarship requires a family income certificate from any of the following, which would be considered for awarding the scholarship
i. Any Government Gazetted Officer not below the rank of BDO in the case of rural areas.
ii. Executive Officer in case of Municipality.
iii. Any Govt. Gazetted Officer not below the rank of Deputy Secretary in case of Corporation.

Any talent in the field of sports, performing arts (e.g. singing, dancing, drama, etc.), visual arts (e.g. painting, sculpture, etc.), who has represented the State or Nation at a National or International level, may be offered 50% scholarship which is equivalent to 50% of the Tuition Fee payable by the student. Depending upon the applicant's merit the scholarship amount may be increased with due approval of the Scholarship Committee.
If the candidate qualifies for his/her previous examination from any of the Institutes under Techno India Group, he/she will be offered a 15% scholarship of tuition fees.
